question: A data scientist is training a large language model on a massive text dataset in Amazon SageMaker. The model is too big to fit on a single GPU. Which feature should they use to distribute the model across multiple GPUs and optimize training?

options.A: Use Pipe Mode to stream data directly from S3 to the training container
options.B: Perform Hyperparameter Tuning to find the best model parameters
options.C: Apply Data Augmentation to expand the training dataset
options.D: Enable Model Parallelism to split the model across multiple GPUs for training

declencheurs: too big to fit on a single GPU
distribute the model across multiple GPUs
radar.signal: Le MODELE (pas les donnees) ne tient pas sur un seul GPU -> Model Parallelism (SageMaker Distributed Model Parallel)

pieges.A: Pipe Mode optimise le streaming des DONNEES depuis S3, sans rapport avec la taille du modele
pieges.B: Le hyperparameter tuning cherche les meilleurs hyperparametres, ne resout pas un probleme de memoire GPU
pieges.C: La data augmentation agit sur le volume/diversite des donnees, pas sur la taille du modele

explication: Quand un modele est trop volumineux pour tenir en memoire sur un seul GPU, il faut repartir ses couches/parametres sur plusieurs GPU : c'est exactement le role du Model Parallelism (SageMaker Distributed Training), a distinguer du Data Parallelism qui repartit les DONNEES (et non le modele) sur plusieurs GPU identiques.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A company has deployed fraud detection model on Amazon SageMaker and configured SageMaker Model Monitor to track model accuracy against a baseline captured at deployment time. Several months later, the monitoring reports show a significant decline in accuracy, even though the model itself has not been updated or retrained. What is the most likely reason for this decrease in accuracy?

options.A: The model's internal structure gradually deteriorated, leading to worse predictions
options.B: SageMaker Model Monitor incorrectly computed the accuracy metric due to a setup issue
options.C: Changes in customer behavior altered the relationship between input features and fraud outcomes over time
options.D: The model automatically tuned its hyperparameters during live inference, reducing accuracy

declencheurs: model itself has not been updated or retrained
radar.signal: Modele inchange mais performance qui se degrade dans le temps -> concept drift (le monde change, pas le modele)

pieges.A: Un modele entraine est un ensemble de poids figes, il ne 'se deteriore' pas tout seul avec le temps
pieges.B: Rien n'indique un probleme de configuration ; c'est un phenomene attendu et documente (concept drift), pas un bug
pieges.D: Un modele deploye ne modifie jamais automatiquement ses hyperparametres pendant l'inference

explication: Le phenomene decrit est le concept drift : la relation entre les features d'entree et la variable cible (ici, la fraude) evolue avec le temps a mesure que le comportement des clients et les tactiques de fraude changent, degradant la pertinence d'un modele pourtant inchange. C'est precisement ce que SageMaker Model Monitor est concu pour detecter en comparant les performances actuelles a la baseline initiale.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A company is developing a web-based AI application on Amazon SageMaker to predict customer purchase behavior. The solution uses SageMaker for training, experimentation, a centralized model registry, real-time deployment, and monitoring. The models are deployed to real-time endpoints, and inference data is captured. The company now wants to run an on-demand workflow to detect bias drift in the deployed models to ensure predictions remain fair and accurate over time. Which solution should the company use?

options.A: Use SageMaker Lineage Tracking to trace experiments and detect bias drift in model predictions
options.B: Use Amazon SageMaker Clarify to run on-demand bias analysis using captured inference data from real-time endpoints
options.C: Use the built-in SageMaker Model Monitor analyzer image to automatically fix bias drift in deployed models
options.D: Use AWS Glue Data Quality to validate datasets and detect bias drift in real-time inference traffic

radar.signal: Analyse de biais A LA DEMANDE sur des donnees d'inference capturees -> SageMaker Clarify

pieges.A: Lineage Tracking trace la provenance/l'historique des experiences et artefacts, il ne detecte pas de biais
pieges.C: Model Monitor peut DETECTER une derive via Clarify, mais aucun service SageMaker ne 'corrige automatiquement' un biais
pieges.D: Glue Data Quality valide la qualite de datasets, ce n'est pas un outil d'analyse de biais de predictions de modele

explication: Amazon SageMaker Clarify fournit des capacites d'analyse de biais a la demande (on-demand), pouvant s'appuyer sur les donnees d'inference capturees par les endpoints temps reel pour verifier que les predictions restent equitables dans le temps, ce qui correspond precisement au workflow ponctuel decrit.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A video streaming startup has deployed a churn prediction model on an Amazon SageMaker real-time endpoint. Because customer behavior changes over time, the team regularly develops new model versions. They want to deploy new models with zero downtime, compare performance using live production traffic, and only fully replace the existing model after the new version proves to perform better. Which approach BEST supports safe rollout and continuous validation in production?

options.A: Automatically deploy the latest model artifact from Amazon S3 using an AWS CodePipeline
options.B: Configure SageMaker Model Monitor to automatically replace models when drift alarms are triggered
options.C: Deploy multiple SageMaker endpoint variants and use weighted traffic routing to evaluate a candidate model before promotion
options.D: Use a scheduled AWS Lambda function to replace the deployed model at fixed time intervals
options.E: Use Amazon Forecast to predict retraining cycles and trigger model redeployment

declencheurs: compare performance using live production traffic
fully replace... after the new version proves to perform better
radar.signal: Comparer un candidat sur du VRAI trafic de prod avant promotion complete -> Production Variants avec routage pondere (A/B testing natif SageMaker)

pieges.A: Deployer automatiquement le dernier artefact remplace directement le modele sans phase de comparaison progressive
pieges.B: Model Monitor detecte la derive mais ne remplace pas automatiquement les modeles ; ce n'est pas un mecanisme de rollout progressif
pieges.D: Remplacer a intervalles fixes ne garantit ni comparaison sur trafic reel ni validation avant promotion
pieges.E: Amazon Forecast sert a la prevision de series temporelles metier, sans rapport avec le rollout de modeles

explication: Les Production Variants d'un endpoint SageMaker permettent d'heberger plusieurs versions de modele simultanement et de repartir le trafic de production entre elles via un poids configurable (ex: 95%/5%), permettant de valider progressivement un nouveau modele sur du trafic reel sans interruption de service, puis d'ajuster les poids jusqu'a remplacement complet une fois sa superiorite confirmee.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: An e-commerce company has built multiple recommendation models, including collaborative filtering, content-based filtering, and a deep learning model. Each model performs best in different situations—for example, collaborative filtering works well for returning users with rich history, while content-based filtering is better for new users with limited data. The team wants to combine these models to deliver more accurate and personalized recommendations across all customer segments. Which strategy is MOST LIKELY to achieve this goal?

options.A: Train several deep learning models on different subsets of data and average their predictions to improve accuracy
options.B: Combine collaborative filtering, content-based filtering, and deep learning outputs using a weighted approach based on performance for different user segments
options.C: Feed predictions from collaborative filtering and content-based filtering into a deep learning model that produces the final recommendation
options.D: Train the models sequentially so each one focuses on correcting the mistakes made by the previous model

declencheurs: each model performs best in different situations
radar.signal: Modeles complementaires selon le segment -> ensemble pondere qui exploite la force de chaque modele selon le contexte

pieges.A: Faire la moyenne de plusieurs deep learning entraines sur des sous-ensembles = du bagging, ne tire pas parti des forces complementaires des DIFFERENTS types de modeles cites
pieges.C: Empiler les sorties dans un modele final (stacking) est valable mais ne cible pas explicitement l'adaptation par segment client decrite dans l'enonce
pieges.D: L'apprentissage sequentiel correctif (boosting) vise a corriger des erreurs globales, pas a ponderer differemment selon le segment utilisateur

explication: Puisque chaque modele excelle sur un segment different (collaborative filtering pour les utilisateurs recurrents, content-based pour les nouveaux utilisateurs), la strategie la plus adaptee est un ensemble pondere dont les poids varient selon le segment/contexte utilisateur, permettant de maximiser la contribution du modele le plus pertinent pour chaque cas plutot que de les traiter uniformement.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A company uses Amazon Redshift as its single source of data, and some of the data stored is sensitive. A data scientist needs to query this sensitive data for analysis. The ML engineer must provide access without transforming the source data and without storing anonymized or masked copies of the data anywhere else. The solution should require the least implementation effort. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Apply dynamic data masking policies so sensitive fields are masked at query time for the data scientist
options.B: Create a materialized view that includes masking logic for sensitive columns
options.C: Grant direct read permissions on the Redshift tables to the data scientist
options.D: Export the Redshift data to Amazon S3 and use Athena schema-on-read with masking rules
options.E: Create and share a standard Redshift view with the data scientist

declencheurs: without storing anonymized or masked copies
radar.signal: Acces direct aux donnees sans transformation ni copie, effort minimal -> simple GRANT de permissions de lecture sur les tables

pieges.A: Le masquage dynamique introduit une logique de transformation a la volee, plus d'implementation qu'un simple GRANT, alors que rien n'exige explicitement un masquage
pieges.B: Une vue materialisee stocke une copie physique des donnees (potentiellement masquees), ce qui viole 'without storing... copies... anywhere else'
pieges.D: Exporter vers S3 cree explicitement une copie des donnees ailleurs, contraire a l'exigence
pieges.E: Creer une vue standard ajoute une couche d'abstraction supplementaire, plus d'effort qu'un GRANT direct sans reel besoin de restreindre des colonnes

explication: Aucune exigence de masquage n'est formulee, seulement l'acces aux donnees sans transformation ni copie et avec le moins d'effort possible. Accorder directement des permissions de lecture (GRANT SELECT) sur les tables Redshift au data scientist est le mecanisme le plus simple et direct, sans creer de vue, de copie ou de logique de masquage superflue.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A bank is developing credit risk models to support loan approval decisions. Due to regulatory requirements, the model's predictions must be interpretable and auditable by loan officers and external regulators. Initial experiments show that deep neural networks achieve slightly higher accuracy but behave like black boxes, while logistic regression is transparent but underperforms. Which approach BEST balances strong predictive performance with model interpretability?

options.A: Train a deep neural network and generate SHAP explanations for every prediction
options.B: Use SageMaker Autopilot to automatically choose the best-performing model and explain results using SageMaker Clarify
options.C: Train a gradient-boosted decision tree model (such as XGBoost) and use feature importance and SHAP values for interpretation
options.D: Use logistic regression and rely on aggressive feature engineering to close the performance gap

declencheurs: balances strong predictive performance with model interpretability
radar.signal: Bon compromis performance/interpretabilite -> arbres de gradient boosting (XGBoost) + SHAP/feature importance

pieges.A: Un reseau de neurones profond reste intrinsequement peu interpretable meme avec des explications SHAP en aval, moins auditable qu'un modele a arbres
pieges.B: Autopilot peut choisir un modele boite noire (ex: deep learning) sans garantir un bon compromis interpretabilite/performance
pieges.D: Forcer la performance de la regression logistique par feature engineering agressif est incertain et ne comble pas forcement l'ecart de performance

explication: Les modeles a base d'arbres de gradient boosting comme XGBoost offrent generalement de meilleures performances que la regression logistique tout en restant plus interpretables qu'un reseau de neurones profond, notamment via l'importance des features et les valeurs SHAP, ce qui en fait le meilleur compromis pour un contexte reglemente exigeant a la fois performance et auditabilite.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A cloud architect needs to deploy a pre-trained AI model for a customer-facing application. Traffic to the application is highly variable, with short bursts of heavy usage and long idle periods. The solution must automatically scale to handle traffic spikes while minimizing costs when idle, and it should require minimal operational and management overhead. Which solution BEST meets these requirements?

options.A: Deploy the model using Amazon SageMaker Serverless Inference with provisioned concurrency to handle traffic fluctuations
options.B: Deploy the model on Amazon ECS using AWS Fargate and configure EventBridge rules to control scaling
options.C: Deploy the model on Amazon ECS backed by EC2 instances and use an Application Load Balancer for traffic distribution
options.D: Deploy the model on a SageMaker real-time endpoint and configure auto scaling based on Amazon CloudWatch metrics

declencheurs: short bursts of heavy usage and long idle periods
radar.signal: Trafic en rafales + longues periodes d'inactivite + zero gestion d'infra -> SageMaker Serverless Inference

pieges.B: ECS Fargate + regles EventBridge de scaling = plus de composants a configurer et gerer soi-meme qu'une offre serverless SageMaker
pieges.C: ECS sur EC2 = infrastructure a gerer en continu, l'option la plus lourde en overhead operationnel
pieges.D: Un endpoint temps reel avec autoscaling CloudWatch garde toujours au moins une instance active, ne descend jamais a zero cout en periode d'inactivite prolongee

explication: SageMaker Serverless Inference est concu specifiquement pour des charges avec des pics courts entrecoupes de longues periodes d'inactivite : AWS gere entierement l'infrastructure et la mise a l'echelle automatique, sans instance a maintenir en permanence, ce qui minimise a la fois le cout en periode creuse et l'overhead operationnel, contrairement aux alternatives basees sur ECS ou sur un endpoint temps reel classique.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: An ML engineer has built a custom Amazon Comprehend model in Account A within the us-east-1 Region. The engineer now needs to copy this model to Account B in the same Region so it can be used there. The solution should require the least development and operational effort. Which option BEST meets this requirement?

options.A: Copy the underlying model artifacts to Amazon S3 and manually move them to Account B
options.B: Transfer a manual copy of the model files from Account A to Account B
options.C: Configure a resource-based IAM policy only, without using any Comprehend APIs
options.D: Use the Amazon Comprehend ImportModel API operation to copy the model to Account B
options.E: Use AWS DataSync to replicate the model data between the two accounts

declencheurs: copy this model to Account B
radar.signal: Copie cross-account d'un modele Comprehend dans la meme region -> ImportModel API (mecanisme natif dedie)

pieges.A: Deplacer manuellement des artefacts n'est pas le mecanisme supporte pour copier un modele Comprehend entre comptes
pieges.B: Un transfert manuel de fichiers = effort de developpement et de gestion bien plus eleve qu'un appel d'API natif
pieges.C: Une resource-based policy seule autorise l'acces mais ne realise pas la copie du modele : il faut aussi appeler ImportModel
pieges.E: AWS DataSync sert a repliquer des donnees de stockage, ce n'est pas concu pour copier un modele Comprehend

explication: L'API ImportModel d'Amazon Comprehend est concue precisement pour copier un modele personnalise d'un compte AWS vers un autre au sein de la meme region, en s'appuyant sur une resource-based policy pour l'autorisation, offrant la solution native au moindre effort de developpement et d'exploitation.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: A transportation company trained a machine learning model in Amazon SageMaker to predict delivery times using real-time traffic data. The model must be deployed to production with the following requirements: High availability with no service interruptions. Low latency for real-time predictions. Ability to process payloads between 1 KB and 5 MB. Handle unpredictable traffic spikes during peak hours. Automatically scale up and down based on demand. Which deployment option BEST satisfies these requirements?

options.A: Use SageMaker Batch Transform to process predictions in batches during peak traffic periods
options.B: Use SageMaker Serverless Inference to automatically scale without managing endpoints
options.C: Deploy the model using SageMaker Real-Time Inference with endpoint auto scaling enabled
options.D: Use SageMaker Asynchronous Inference to efficiently process request spikes while meeting strict latency goals

declencheurs: high availability with no service interruptions
radar.signal: Faible latence garantie + haute dispo continue + payload jusqu'a 5 MB -> SageMaker Real-Time Inference avec autoscaling (Serverless limite a 4 MB, insuffisant)

pieges.A: Batch Transform traite hors-ligne par lots, incompatible avec des predictions temps reel
pieges.B: Serverless Inference limite le payload a 4 MB (< 5 MB requis) et peut souffrir de cold starts, contraire a 'no service interruptions'
pieges.D: Asynchronous Inference est concu pour du near-real-time avec file d'attente, pas pour de la faible latence stricte garantie en continu

explication: Un endpoint SageMaker Real-Time Inference avec autoscaling garantit une faible latence constante et une disponibilite continue (instances toujours actives, scaling automatique face aux pics), et supporte des payloads jusqu'a 6 MB, couvrant la plage de 1 KB a 5 MB requise, contrairement a Serverless Inference dont la limite de payload de 4 MB est insuffisante.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: A Machine Learning Specialist needs to ingest streaming data and store it in Apache Parquet files for downstream exploration and analysis. Which AWS service can both ingest the streaming data and store it directly in Parquet format?

options.A: AWS Database Migration Service (DMS)
options.B: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
options.C: Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose
options.D: Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics

declencheurs: store it directly in Parquet format
radar.signal: Ingestion de flux + conversion automatique en Parquet a la livraison -> Kinesis Data Firehose (format conversion built-in)

pieges.A: DMS migre des bases de donnees, ce n'est pas un service d'ingestion de flux streaming
pieges.B: Kinesis Data Streams ingere le flux brut mais ne convertit/stocke pas nativement en Parquet, il faut un consommateur en aval
pieges.D: Kinesis Data Analytics traite/transforme un flux en temps reel (SQL/Flink), ce n'est pas lui qui ecrit le fichier de sortie en Parquet

explication: Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose peut a la fois ingerer un flux de donnees et convertir automatiquement le format de sortie en Apache Parquet avant de le livrer vers S3, grace a sa fonctionnalite native de conversion de format, sans code ni service supplementaire a orchestrer.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A machine learning engineer has deployed a model using Amazon SageMaker into production. The engineer wants to monitor the model's real-time performance, including metrics such as prediction accuracy, data drift, and model quality, to ensure it continues to perform reliably over time. Which AWS service is BEST suited for this purpose?

options.A: Amazon SageMaker Autopilot
options.B: Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor
options.C: AWS Glue
options.D: Amazon CloudWatch

declencheurs: prediction accuracy, data drift, and model quality
continues to perform reliably over time
radar.signal: Surveillance combinee derive donnees + qualite modele -> SageMaker Model Monitor (service dedie a cet usage precis)

pieges.A: Autopilot sert a entrainer/tuner automatiquement des modeles, pas a les surveiller en production
pieges.C: AWS Glue est un service ETL, sans rapport avec le monitoring de modele ML en production
pieges.D: CloudWatch fournit l'infrastructure de metriques/alarmes generique sous-jacente, mais c'est Model Monitor qui calcule specifiquement la derive et la qualite du modele ML

explication: SageMaker Model Monitor est le service specifiquement concu pour surveiller en continu les modeles deployes sur SageMaker : il detecte la derive des donnees d'entree, la derive de qualite des predictions et la derive de biais, en s'appuyant sur CloudWatch pour l'alerting, ce qui en fait la solution la mieux adaptee par rapport aux alternatives plus generiques.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A company has a large set of chat recordings from customer interactions after a product release. An ML engineer needs to quickly evaluate customer sentiment to determine the success of the product. Which approach will allow the ML engineer to complete this evaluation in the least amount of time?

options.A: Use Amazon Rekognition to detect sentiment in chat conversations
options.B: Train a Naive Bayes classifier to classify chat sentiments
options.C: Use a random forest model to classify chat sentiments
options.D: Use Amazon Comprehend to analyze sentiment in chat conversations

radar.signal: Sentiment sur du texte, rapidite maximale -> API prete a l'emploi Amazon Comprehend, aucun entrainement requis

pieges.A: Rekognition analyse des images/videos, pas du texte de chat
pieges.B: Entrainer un classifieur Naive Bayes custom demande de la collecte de labels, de l'entrainement et de la validation : bien plus long qu'un appel API
pieges.C: Meme probleme qu'avec Naive Bayes : entrainer un random forest prend du temps, contraire a 'least amount of time'

explication: Amazon Comprehend fournit une API de detection de sentiment pretrainee, utilisable immediatement sans collecte de donnees labellisees ni entrainement de modele, ce qui permet d'evaluer le sentiment des conversations dans le delai le plus court possible, contrairement a l'entrainement d'un classifieur custom.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A Machine Learning Specialist built a deep learning image classification model, but noticed overfitting: the training accuracy is 99%, while the test accuracy is only 75%. Which action should the specialist take to reduce overfitting, and why?

options.A: Increase the learning rate because the optimizer may be stuck in a local minimum
options.B: Increase the dropout rate at the flatten layer because the model is not generalized enough
options.C: Increase the number of neurons in the dense layer because the model is not complex enough
options.D: Increase the number of epochs because training stopped before reaching the global minimum

declencheurs: training accuracy is 99%, while the test accuracy is only 75%
radar.signal: Grand ecart train/test -> overfitting -> augmenter la regularisation (dropout), pas la capacite du modele

pieges.A: Augmenter le learning rate s'attaque a un probleme de convergence, pas d'overfitting
pieges.C: Ajouter des neurones augmente la capacite du modele, ce qui aggraverait l'overfitting au lieu de le reduire
pieges.D: Plus d'epochs avec un modele deja en surapprentissage ne fera qu'accentuer l'ecart train/test

explication: Un ecart important entre une accuracy d'entrainement tres elevee (99%) et une accuracy de test bien plus faible (75%) est la signature classique d'un overfitting : le modele memorise les donnees d'entrainement au lieu de generaliser. Augmenter le taux de dropout ajoute de la regularisation qui force le reseau a moins dependre de neurones specifiques, ameliorant la generalisation.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A company uses a machine learning model to predict customer demand. Cleaned training data is uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket every 3-4 days. Currently, a SageMaker pipeline retrains the model manually whenever new data arrives. An ML engineer is tasked with automating pipeline execution whenever new data is uploaded to S3, with minimal operational effort. Which solution BEST meets this requirement?

options.A: Enable Amazon EventBridge for the S3 bucket and create a rule to trigger the SageMaker pipeline whenever an S3 upload occurs
options.B: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy with an event pattern for new object creation to trigger the SageMaker pipeline
options.C: Use Amazon S3 Event Notifications to detect uploads and directly set the SageMaker pipeline as the notification destination
options.D: Schedule a cron job that checks for new S3 files daily, invokes a Lambda function, and triggers the SageMaker pipeline

declencheurs: automating pipeline execution whenever new data is uploaded
radar.signal: Declenchement automatique d'un SageMaker Pipeline sur upload S3 -> EventBridge (cible native 'Start pipeline execution')

pieges.B: Une Lifecycle policy gere la transition/expiration d'objets S3, ce n'est pas un mecanisme de declenchement d'evenements
pieges.C: Les destinations natives des S3 Event Notifications sont Lambda/SNS/SQS uniquement, pas directement un SageMaker Pipeline
pieges.D: Un cron quotidien introduit un delai (jusqu'a 24h) et un composant Lambda supplementaire a maintenir, plus lourd qu'une regle EventBridge directe

explication: Amazon EventBridge peut recevoir les evenements de creation d'objet S3 et cibler directement une execution de SageMaker Pipeline nativement comme cible de regle, sans necessiter de fonction Lambda intermediaire ni de polling planifie, ce qui minimise l'effort operationnel pour automatiser le declenchement du pipeline.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: A marketing analyst has developed a binary classification model using an external framework and stored the model artifacts in Amazon S3. The analyst wants to share the model with a colleague via Amazon SageMaker Canvas for further tuning and analysis. Both users are part of the same SageMaker domain. Which requirements must be met to successfully share the model with the Canvas user? (Choose two)

options.A: The Canvas user must have permissions to access the S3 bucket where the model artifacts are stored
options.B: The Canvas user must be part of the SageMaker domain and have permissions to access the S3 bucket
options.C: The Canvas user must be configured in the SageMaker domain, and Autopilot must be used to share the ML model
options.D: The latest version of SageMaker Studio is required; Studio Classic does not support sharing models to Canvas
options.E: The model must be registered in the SageMaker Model Registry

declencheurs: share the model with a colleague via SageMaker Canvas
both users are part of the same SageMaker domain
radar.signal: Partager un modele externe vers Canvas -> il doit etre enregistre dans le Model Registry + l'utilisateur Canvas doit avoir acces au S3 des artefacts

pieges.B: L'appartenance au meme domaine SageMaker est deja donnee dans l'enonce, ce n'est donc pas une condition manquante a satisfaire
pieges.C: Autopilot n'est pas requis pour partager un modele externe importe vers Canvas
pieges.D: Aucune version specifique de Studio n'est une condition documentee de partage vers Canvas, c'est un distracteur

explication: Pour qu'un modele externe soit exploitable dans SageMaker Canvas par un autre utilisateur du meme domaine, il doit d'abord etre enregistre dans le SageMaker Model Registry (mecanisme de partage/decouverte de modeles entre Studio et Canvas), et l'utilisateur Canvas doit disposer des permissions IAM pour acceder au bucket S3 contenant les artefacts du modele.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: A data scientist is preparing datasets for a machine learning project. The datasets contain missing values, duplicate records, and outliers. The goal is to clean and consolidate all datasets into a single data frame, ensuring the data is ready for ML model training. Which approach is the most efficient to achieve this?

options.A: Use Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth to import and consolidate the datasets, leveraging human-in-the-loop to clean and prepare the data
options.B: Use the SageMaker Python SDK to merge datasets into a single pandas data frame and perform transformations manually
options.C: Use Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler to import, merge, clean, and preprocess the datasets using its built-in transformation functionalities
options.D: Manually merge the datasets, save to S3, use Amazon Athena to transform the data, and visualize in Amazon QuickSight

declencheurs: missing values, duplicate records, and outliers
radar.signal: Nettoyage + fusion + preprocessing multi-datasets, efficacite maximale -> SageMaker Data Wrangler (transformations pretes a l'emploi)

pieges.A: Ground Truth sert au labelling avec human-in-the-loop, pas au nettoyage/fusion de datasets
pieges.B: Un script pandas manuel via le SDK demande d'ecrire et maintenir du code pour chaque transformation, moins efficace qu'un outil visuel dedie
pieges.D: Fusion manuelle + Athena + QuickSight = chaine d'outils multiple et plus d'etapes manuelles qu'un seul outil integre

explication: SageMaker Data Wrangler propose des transformations pretes a l'emploi pour importer plusieurs sources, fusionner des datasets, gerer les valeurs manquantes, dedupliquer et traiter les outliers via une interface visuelle, ce qui est nettement plus efficace qu'un script pandas manuel ou une chaine d'outils disparates (Athena/QuickSight).
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: In the context of generative AI models, which statement correctly distinguishes model parameters from hyperparameters?

options.A: Both hyperparameters and model parameters are adjustable values that customize the training process
options.B: Both hyperparameters and model parameters define a model and its behavior in interpreting inputs and generating responses
options.C: Model parameters define a model and its behavior in interpreting input and generating responses. Hyperparameters are adjustable values that control the training process
options.D: Hyperparameters define a model and its behavior, while model parameters control training adjustments

radar.signal: Question de definition -> parametres du modele = appris (poids) ; hyperparametres = choisis avant/pendant l'entrainement pour le controler

pieges.A: Les parametres du modele ne sont pas 'ajustes' manuellement pour customiser l'entrainement, ils sont appris automatiquement
pieges.B: Les hyperparametres ne definissent pas le comportement d'interpretation du modele, ils controlent la maniere dont il est entraine
pieges.D: Inverse completement les deux definitions

explication: Les parametres du modele (ex: poids d'un reseau de neurones) sont appris automatiquement pendant l'entrainement et definissent directement le comportement du modele face a une entree donnee. Les hyperparametres (ex: learning rate, nombre de couches) sont des valeurs fixees avant ou entre les entrainements pour controler le PROCESSUS d'apprentissage lui-meme, sans etre appris par le modele.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: You are building a real-time fraud detection system for a financial services company. The model must be highly accurate to minimize false positives and false negatives, retrain frequently to adapt to new fraud patterns, and fit within a limited budget for cloud resources. Which strategy is most likely to balance accuracy, training time, and cost?

options.A: Implement a tree-based model like XGBoost with early stopping and hyperparameter tuning, balancing accuracy with shorter training time and lower computational cost
options.B: Use a support vector machine (SVM) with a nonlinear kernel to maximize accuracy, ignoring higher training time and cost for large datasets
options.C: Deploy a simple model like logistic regression to minimize training time and cost, while accepting a moderate drop in accuracy
options.D: Train a deep neural network with multiple layers to maximize performance, even if it requires high compute and long training time

declencheurs: balance accuracy, training time, and cost
radar.signal: Reentrainements frequents + budget limite + bonne accuracy -> XGBoost avec early stopping/HPO, le meilleur compromis des trois

pieges.B: SVM a noyau non lineaire sur de larges volumes = tres couteux en temps/calcul, l'enonce dit explicitement d'arreter d'ignorer ce cout
pieges.C: La regression logistique minimise le cout mais sacrifie l'accuracy, alors que le systeme doit rester 'highly accurate'
pieges.D: Un deep learning multi-couches maximise la performance au prix d'un cout et d'un temps d'entrainement eleves, incompatibles avec un budget limite et des reentrainements frequents

explication: XGBoost avec early stopping et tuning d'hyperparametres offre un excellent compromis entre precision, rapidite d'entrainement et cout de calcul, ce qui le rend particulierement adapte a un systeme necessitant des reentrainements frequents sous contrainte budgetaire, contrairement a un SVM a noyau non lineaire ou un deep learning profond, plus couteux, ou une regression logistique, moins precise.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A media streaming company processes video metadata using AWS Glue jobs orchestrated by a Glue workflow. These jobs run on a schedule or manually. The company is building Amazon SageMaker Pipelines to develop ML models predicting user engagement. The pipelines require processed metadata from AWS Glue jobs during feature engineering. Which solution provides seamless integration with the least operational overhead?

options.A: Integrate the AWS Glue jobs as SageMaker Pipeline processing steps to handle data preprocessing within the pipeline
options.B: Build a custom Python orchestration script to manage both Glue workflows and SageMaker Pipelines, ensuring data dependencies
options.C: Use SageMaker Pipeline callback steps to wait for Glue jobs to finish and retrieve outputs directly from Amazon S3
options.D: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to trigger the SageMaker pipeline after Glue job completion and pass metadata via AWS Lambda

declencheurs: SageMaker Pipelines require processed metadata from Glue jobs
seamless integration with the least operational overhead
radar.signal: Integrer un job Glue EXTERNE existant dans un SageMaker Pipeline -> CallbackStep (mecanisme natif documente pour Glue/EMR)

pieges.A: Il n'existe pas de type de step SageMaker Pipeline natif qui 'devient' directement un job Glue existant ; le mecanisme officiel pour cela est le CallbackStep
pieges.B: Une orchestration custom en Python duplique une fonctionnalite deja native (CallbackStep), plus d'effort et de maintenance
pieges.D: EventBridge + Lambda ajoute des composants supplementaires a construire et maintenir alors que le CallbackStep est concu nativement pour ce cas

explication: AWS documente specifiquement le CallbackStep de SageMaker Pipelines comme le mecanisme natif pour integrer des jobs externes comme AWS Glue ou EMR dans un pipeline : le pipeline se met en pause via un jeton envoye a une file SQS, et reprend automatiquement une fois le job Glue termine, recuperant ses sorties depuis S3, sans avoir a construire d'orchestration custom supplementaire.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: An organization has a large collection of medical documents. They want to categorize documents automatically based on the terms in each document, without predefined categories. A Machine Learning specialist is exploring Amazon SageMaker AI and LLMs for topic modeling and natural language understanding to discover hidden topics and improve categorization. Which built-in SageMaker algorithm is the most suitable for this task?

options.A: BlazingText algorithm in text classification mode
options.B: Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) algorithm for unsupervised topic discovery
options.C: Semantic segmentation algorithm for labeling regions in images
options.D: CatBoost algorithm for tabular data classification and regression

radar.signal: Categorisation SANS labels predefinis -> topic modeling non supervise -> LDA

pieges.A: BlazingText en mode classification est SUPERVISE, il necessite des categories predefinies et des labels
pieges.C: La segmentation semantique concerne des images, pas des documents texte
pieges.D: CatBoost traite des donnees tabulaires structurees, pas du texte non structure pour du topic modeling

explication: Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) est un algorithme de topic modeling non supervise, disponible en built-in dans SageMaker, qui decouvre automatiquement des themes latents dans une collection de documents a partir de la distribution des termes, sans necessiter de categories predefinies, ce qui correspond exactement au besoin decrit.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A transportation company wants to track vehicle locations in near real-time using GPS devices. The location data must be stored in Amazon Redshift to support real-time analytics and dashboard reporting. Which ingestion workflow provides the fastest processing time from data capture to storage?

options.A: Ingest data with Amazon Kinesis Data Streams and load it into Redshift using Redshift Streaming Ingestion
options.B: Ingest data with Amazon MSK (Kafka) and use Redshift Spectrum to query data in the cluster
options.C: Ingest data with Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose and set Redshift as the delivery destination
options.D: Ingest data with Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose, then use Redshift Streaming Ingestion to load the streaming data

declencheurs: fastest processing time from data capture to storage
radar.signal: Latence minimale entre capture et stockage Redshift -> Redshift Streaming Ingestion directement depuis Kinesis Data Streams, sans etape intermediaire

pieges.B: Redshift Spectrum interroge des donnees dans S3, il ne charge pas en continu un flux MSK dans les tables Redshift en temps reel
pieges.C: Firehose vers Redshift introduit un buffering (souvent plusieurs minutes) avant livraison, plus lent qu'une ingestion directe en streaming
pieges.D: Faire passer les donnees par Firheose AVANT Redshift Streaming Ingestion ajoute une etape et donc de la latence par rapport a une ingestion directe depuis Kinesis Data Streams

explication: La fonctionnalite Redshift Streaming Ingestion permet de connecter directement un flux Amazon Kinesis Data Streams a Redshift sans etape intermediaire de staging (contrairement a Firehose qui introduit un intervalle de buffering), offrant le temps de traitement le plus court entre la capture GPS et sa disponibilite pour l'analytique.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: An AI assistant was previously trained to manage calendars and has recently been trained on a new task like booking flights. After the new training, its performance on calendar management degrades significantly. What is this phenomenon called, and how can it be mitigated?

options.A: Overfitting
options.B: Underfitting
options.C: Catastrophic forgetting
options.D: Data imbalance

declencheurs: recently trained on a new task
radar.signal: Perte de performance sur une ancienne tache apres entrainement sur une nouvelle tache -> catastrophic forgetting

pieges.A: L'overfitting designe une trop bonne memorisation des donnees d'entrainement au detriment de la generalisation, pas la perte d'une competence anterieure
pieges.B: L'underfitting designe un modele trop simple qui n'apprend pas bien, sans rapport avec la perte d'une tache deja maitrisee
pieges.D: Le desequilibre de classes concerne la distribution des labels dans un dataset, pas la perte de competence entre taches sequentielles

explication: Le catastrophic forgetting survient lorsqu'un modele entraine sequentiellement sur une nouvelle tache 'ecrase' les poids qui encodaient une competence precedente, degradant fortement sa performance sur l'ancienne tache. On l'attenue avec des techniques comme le rehearsal (reentrainer aussi sur des exemples de l'ancienne tache), l'apprentissage multi-tache conjoint, ou des methodes de regularisation dediees (ex: Elastic Weight Consolidation).
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A company wants to analyze customer emotions from product review videos. The analysis should capture both: Visual emotions from customers' faces. Sentiment of spoken feedback. Which combination of AWS AI services can best accomplish this?

options.A: Amazon Rekognition, Amazon Transcribe, and Amazon Comprehend
options.B: Amazon Rekognition, Amazon Translate, and Amazon Comprehend
options.C: Amazon Rekognition, Amazon Polly, and Amazon Comprehend
options.D: Amazon Rekognition, Amazon Translate, and Amazon Transcribe

radar.signal: Emotion visage (image) + parole -> texte + sentiment -> Rekognition (visage) + Transcribe (speech-to-text) + Comprehend (sentiment)

pieges.B: Translate traduit du texte d'une langue a une autre, ne convertit pas la parole en texte : il manque l'etape de transcription
pieges.C: Polly convertit du TEXTE en PAROLE (sens inverse de ce qui est requis), inutile ici
pieges.D: Sans Comprehend, rien n'analyse le sentiment du texte transcrit

explication: Amazon Rekognition detecte les emotions faciales dans les images/videos, Amazon Transcribe convertit la parole des retours clients en texte, puis Amazon Comprehend analyse le sentiment de ce texte transcrit : la combinaison des trois couvre a la fois l'analyse visuelle et l'analyse du contenu parle, contrairement aux autres combinaisons qui omettent une etape necessaire (transcription ou analyse de sentiment).
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: An ML engineer is training a recurrent neural network (RNN) for electricity demand forecasting using stochastic gradient descent (SGD). During training, the training loss and validation loss remain high and oscillate—decreasing for a few epochs, then increasing again repeatedly. What action should the engineer take to stabilize training and improve model performance?

options.A: Reduce the learning rate to allow gradient updates to converge more smoothly and prevent oscillations in loss
options.B: Increase the number of epochs to give the model more time to learn the data patterns
options.C: Increase the learning rate to allow gradient updates to converge more smoothly and prevent oscillations in loss
options.D: Apply dropout regularization to the RNN layers to improve generalization and reduce oscillations in loss

declencheurs: decreasing for a few epochs, then increasing again repeatedly
radar.signal: Meme signature qu'un LR trop eleve (Q41) : oscillations repetees de la loss -> reduire le learning rate

pieges.B: Plus d'epochs ne resout pas une instabilite d'optimisation due a un pas de gradient trop grand, l'oscillation persistera
pieges.C: Augmenter encore le learning rate aggraverait les oscillations au lieu de les stabiliser
pieges.D: Le dropout ameliore la generalisation (overfitting) mais ne traite pas une instabilite de convergence liee au learning rate

explication: Une loss d'entrainement ET de validation qui oscille de maniere repetee (baisse puis remonte) est la signature typique d'un learning rate trop eleve avec SGD : les pas de mise a jour sont trop grands et font 'depasser' le minimum a chaque iteration. Reduire le learning rate permet des mises a jour plus fines qui convergent de maniere stable.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A Machine Learning engineer is building a model to predict house prices in a specific location. Which metric should be used to evaluate the model's performance?

options.A: Accuracy
options.B: Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC)
options.C: F1 score
options.D: Mean Absolute Error (MAE)

radar.signal: Prediction d'une valeur continue (prix) -> probleme de REGRESSION -> metrique de regression (MAE), pas de classification

pieges.A: L'accuracy est une metrique de classification, inadaptee a une prediction de valeur continue
pieges.B: L'AUC evalue un classifieur binaire, sans rapport avec une regression de prix
pieges.C: Le F1 score combine precision/rappel pour la classification, pas pour la regression

explication: Predire un prix immobilier est un probleme de regression (valeur continue), pas de classification. Le Mean Absolute Error (MAE) est une metrique de regression standard qui mesure l'ecart moyen entre predictions et valeurs reelles, contrairement a Accuracy, AUC et F1 score qui sont toutes des metriques de classification.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A Machine Learning Engineer needs to deploy a small ML model for low-latency, real-time inference. The traffic pattern is bursty and unpredictable, and the solution must require minimal operational overhead using a serverless deployment approach. Which option BEST meets these requirements?

options.A: Amazon SageMaker real-time endpoint
options.B: Amazon EC2 behind Amazon API Gateway
options.C: AWS Lambda + Amazon API Gateway
options.D: Amazon SageMaker Asynchronous Inference

radar.signal: Le mot 'serverless' est explicite -> Lambda + API Gateway, l'archetype de l'architecture serverless sur AWS

pieges.A: Un endpoint SageMaker temps reel maintient des instances actives en permanence, ce n'est pas une architecture serverless
pieges.B: EC2 derriere API Gateway necessite de gerer des instances, contraire a 'serverless'
pieges.D: Asynchronous Inference n'est pas concu pour de la faible latence temps reel, plutot du near-real-time en file d'attente

explication: Pour un petit modele avec un trafic en rafales imprevisible et une exigence explicite de 'serverless', AWS Lambda associe a API Gateway est l'architecture serverless de reference : aucune instance a gerer, scaling automatique instantane, facturation a l'usage, ce qui correspond exactement aux quatre criteres (petit modele, faible latence, bursty, serverless).
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: A lab is running multiple Amazon EMR clusters to process large-scale sequencing data. The team needs strong security auditing and real-time operational monitoring of the EMR environments, while maintaining a reliable analytics setup. Which combination of AWS services provides comprehensive auditing and real-time cluster observability?

options.A: Amazon EMR + Amazon GuardDuty + AWS Security Hub
options.B: Amazon EMR + Amazon VPC + AWS Lambda
options.C: Amazon EMR + AWS CloudTrail + Amazon CloudWatch
options.D: Amazon EMR + AWS KMS + Amazon Redshift

declencheurs: comprehensive auditing and real-time cluster observability
radar.signal: Audit + monitoring operationnel temps reel -> CloudTrail (audit des appels API) + CloudWatch (metriques/logs temps reel)

pieges.A: GuardDuty/Security Hub detectent des menaces et centralisent la posture de securite, ce n'est pas un audit d'activite ni un monitoring operationnel de cluster
pieges.B: VPC et Lambda ne fournissent ni audit ni monitoring en tant que tels
pieges.D: KMS gere le chiffrement des cles, Redshift est un entrepot de donnees : aucun des deux n'audite ni ne monitore EMR

explication: AWS CloudTrail journalise tous les appels API (qui a fait quoi et quand) pour l'audit de securite, tandis qu'Amazon CloudWatch collecte en temps reel les metriques et logs operationnels des clusters EMR, offrant ensemble la combinaison exacte d'audit et d'observabilite demandee.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A company is building a web-based AI application using Amazon SageMaker. The application must support. ML experimentation and training. A central model registry. Model deployment and monitoring. Secure and isolated access to training data stored in Amazon S3. The company also needs to manage and track multiple versions of ML models with the least operational overhead. Which action BEST meets these requirements?

options.A: Use the SageMaker Model Registry and model groups to catalog the models
options.B: Use Amazon ECR with unique image tags for each model version
options.C: Create a separate Amazon ECR repository for each model
options.D: Use the SageMaker Model Registry with unique tags for each model version

declencheurs: manage and track multiple versions of ML models
radar.signal: Suivi de versions de modeles avec effort minimal -> SageMaker Model Registry + model groups (mecanisme natif de regroupement de versions)

pieges.B: ECR stocke des images de conteneurs, pas des versions de modeles ML avec metadonnees de registre
pieges.C: Un repository ECR par modele = gestion eclatee et plus lourde qu'un registre centralise
pieges.D: Le Model Registry existe deja pour grouper nativement les versions ; s'appuyer sur des tags custom en plus des model groups ajoute de la complexite inutile

explication: Les 'model package groups' du SageMaker Model Registry sont concus nativement pour regrouper et versionner plusieurs iterations d'un meme modele, avec suivi de statut d'approbation, offrant une gestion centralisee avec le moins d'overhead operationnel, contrairement a une gestion via des tags ECR ou des repositories separes.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: You are a lead program manager for a multinational company and you are running multiple ML initiatives (personalized ranking, fraud detection, demand forecasting). Finance requires monthly, auditable, project-level cost reports, and each team must stay within a quarterly budget. You want a repeatable, low-maintenance way to attribute and report AWS spend by project, team, and environment across ML services. Which approach is the MOST effective?

options.A: Create separate AWS accounts for each ML project and reconcile costs from consolidated billing
options.B: Implement a consistent cost-allocation tagging strategy and use AWS Cost Explorer
options.C: Enable AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR) and query spend in Athena without tags, grouping by resource IDs
options.D: Configure AWS Budgets for each project and rely on alerts, adjusting spend manually after thresholds are reached

declencheurs: attribute and report AWS spend by project, team, and environment
radar.signal: Attribution de couts recurrente et peu couteuse en maintenance -> tagging de cost-allocation + Cost Explorer

pieges.A: Multiplier les comptes AWS par projet est une refonte organisationnelle lourde, pas une solution 'low-maintenance'
pieges.C: Grouper par ID de ressource sans tags est fragile et peu lisible pour des rapports par projet/equipe/environnement
pieges.D: Les Budgets alertent sur des seuils mais ne fournissent pas en soi des rapports mensuels detailles et auditable par dimension

explication: Une strategie de tags de cost-allocation (project, team, environment) appliquee de maniere coherente sur toutes les ressources ML, combinee a AWS Cost Explorer pour filtrer/exporter des rapports par dimension, offre une solution repetable et peu couteuse en maintenance pour l'attribution mensuelle et auditable des couts, sans refonte de l'architecture de comptes.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A data scientist in financial institution using a machine learning model to predict loan defaults. The model was trained on historical data from the last several years. After several months in production, the model's accuracy has steadily declined. Further analysis suggests that economic changes and evolving customer behavior have altered the underlying data distribution, resulting in model drift. Which combination of approaches should you use to detect and manage model drift effectively? (Choose two)

options.A: Retrain the model using the most recent data and apply model versioning
options.B: Implement continuous monitoring of input features and model predictions using statistical tests
options.C: Deploy an alternative model trained on different data and compare predictions with the existing model
options.D: Reduce model complexity by removing features and layers so the model can generalize across changing data distributions
options.E: Increase model complexity by adding more features and deeper layers

radar.signal: Detecter ET gerer la derive -> surveillance statistique continue (detection) + reentrainement versionne (gestion/reponse)

pieges.C: Comparer a un modele challenger est une pratique valide mais plus lourde/secondaire, pas la reponse standard 'detecter + gerer'
pieges.D: Simplifier le modele n'a aucun rapport avec un changement de distribution des donnees dans le temps
pieges.E: Complexifier le modele ne corrige pas un desalignement entre donnees d'entrainement passees et donnees actuelles

explication: La detection du drift passe par une surveillance continue des features d'entree et des predictions via des tests statistiques (ex: SageMaker Model Monitor), tandis que la gestion du drift consiste a reentrainer regulierement le modele sur des donnees recentes en versionnant chaque nouvelle iteration, ce qui forme le cycle complet detection-reponse face a l'evolution de la distribution des donnees.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: You are a Machine Learning Engineer at a startup building a real-time recommendation engine for an e-commerce platform. The system has two types of workloads. Training, Sporadic jobs on large datasets, requiring significant compute power. Inference, Real-time requests with traffic that fluctuates throughout the day. The company is cost-conscious and wants to balance scalability, performance, and cost efficiency. Which resource allocation strategy is most suitable for training and inference under these constraints?

options.A: Use on-demand instances for training to scale flexibly, and provisioned inference endpoints with auto-scaling to handle traffic bursts efficiently while controlling costs
options.B: Use provisioned instances with reserved capacity for both training and inference to guarantee availability and lock in predictable costs
options.C: Use on-demand instances for both training and inference so you pay only for resources when they are in use, without any upfront commitments
options.D: Use spot instances for both training and inference to minimize cost, accepting potential interruptions during execution

declencheurs: real-time requests with traffic that fluctuates
balance scalability, performance, and cost efficiency
radar.signal: Deux profils differents -> traitement adapte a chacun : training ponctuel = On-Demand flexible ; inference temps reel = endpoint provisionne + autoscaling

pieges.B: Reserver de la capacite pour un training SPORADIQUE gaspille des couts sur du temps inutilise
pieges.C: On-Demand pour l'inference TEMPS REEL sans endpoint provisionne/autoscaling ne garantit ni la faible latence ni la gestion des pics
pieges.D: Le Spot pour l'inference temps reel expose le service a des interruptions, incompatible avec un besoin de reponses fiables en continu

explication: Le training etant sporadique, des instances On-Demand permettent de payer uniquement lors des sessions d'entrainement sans engagement. L'inference etant en temps reel avec une charge fluctuante, un endpoint provisionne avec autoscaling garantit la disponibilite et la faible latence tout en ajustant automatiquement la capacite (et donc le cout) selon la demande, offrant le meilleur equilibre scalabilite/performance/cout pour ces deux profils distincts.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: A streaming service is developing a personalized recommendation system using viewer's watch and search behavior. The current model performs very well on training data but fails to generalize to new users, showing overfitting. Traffic is expected to triple next quarter, so the solution must also remain scalable. Which strategy is most suitable to reduce overfitting and improve generalization?

options.A: Use k-fold cross-validation and simplify the model to reduce overfitting while improving generalization
options.B: Increase the network size and depth to capture more complex user interactions
options.C: Use Amazon SageMaker Automatic Model Tuning to find the optimal hyperparameters
options.D: Add batch normalization layers to stabilize training and speed up convergence

declencheurs: fails to generalize to new users
radar.signal: Overfitting explicite -> validation croisee + simplification du modele (action directe sur la cause), pas de complexification

pieges.B: Augmenter la taille/profondeur du reseau accroit la capacite du modele, ce qui aggrave l'overfitting
pieges.C: L'Automatic Model Tuning optimise des hyperparametres en general, mais ne cible pas specifiquement la reduction d'overfitting comme le fait la simplification + validation croisee
pieges.D: La batch normalization stabilise/accelere l'entrainement, ce n'est pas une technique de reduction d'overfitting en soi

explication: Le k-fold cross-validation permet d'evaluer la generalisation de maniere plus fiable, et simplifier le modele (moins de parametres) reduit directement sa capacite a memoriser le bruit des donnees d'entrainement, ce qui traite directement la cause de l'overfitting observe, tout en produisant un modele plus leger donc naturellement plus scalable face a la hausse de trafic attendue.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: You are a Machine Learning Engineer and responsible for deploying a customer churn prediction model in Amazon SageMaker. The model is critical for proactive retention, so high availability and reliability are essential. You also need to implement model versioning and rollback strategies to quickly respond to issues with new model versions. Which deployment approach best follows industry best practices for production ML models?

options.A: Deploy the new model directly to production, monitor performance, and retrain immediately if issues arise
options.B: Deploy the updated model version alongside the existing production model using a blue/green deployment, switch traffic gradually, and roll back if any problems occur
options.C: Tag the new model version, use weighted traffic routing to gradually send traffic to it, and increase traffic if it performs well
options.D: Deploy the new version in a staging environment, test thoroughly, and then manually replace the production model if no issues occur

declencheurs: high availability and reliability are essential
radar.signal: Rollback rapide explicitement exige -> blue/green avec bascule progressive ET rollback prevu

pieges.A: Deployer directement en prod sans phase de comparaison expose tous les utilisateurs au risque avant validation
pieges.C: Decrit un rollout progressif mais ne mentionne aucune strategie de rollback en cas de probleme, contrairement a l'exigence enoncee
pieges.D: Un remplacement manuel apres tests en staging ne garantit pas de detection de probleme sur du trafic reel ni de rollback rapide automatise

explication: Un deploiement blue/green fait cohabiter l'ancienne et la nouvelle version, bascule le trafic progressivement pour valider la nouvelle version en conditions reelles, et surtout prevoit explicitement un rollback immediat en cas de probleme, ce qui repond precisement aux exigences de haute disponibilite et de reponse rapide aux incidents, contrairement aux autres options qui omettent une vraie strategie de rollback.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: A retail marketplace has deployed an image classification model in Amazon SageMaker to detect damaged inventory. Training used clean images from a single location, but after deployment, accuracy dropped because cameras across 14 fulfillment centers produce images with different lighting, noise, and compression artifacts. What is the fastest, lowest-effort approach to improve the model's robustness to these variations?

options.A: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to augment the training set with lighting changes, blur, noise, and compression artifacts, then retrain the model
options.B: Build a lightweight inference preprocessor to filter out low-quality images before sending them to the model
options.C: Collect a new, diverse dataset from all fulfillment center cameras and fine-tune the model
options.D: Apply SageMaker Data Wrangler's outlier detection to remove anomalous images from the training set

declencheurs: different lighting, noise, and compression artifacts
radar.signal: Variabilite visuelle connue (lumiere/bruit/compression) -> augmentation de donnees simulant ces variations sur le dataset EXISTANT, rapide et peu couteux

pieges.B: Filtrer les images de mauvaise qualite reduit le volume de donnees utilisables sans rendre le modele plus robuste a ces variations
pieges.C: Collecter un nouveau dataset diversifie depuis 14 sites est plus lent et plus couteux qu'augmenter les donnees existantes
pieges.D: Supprimer les images 'anormales' va a l'encontre du besoin : on veut au contraire que le modele apprenne CES variations, pas les exclure

explication: La data augmentation dans SageMaker Data Wrangler permet de simuler directement sur le dataset propre existant les variations rencontrees en production (luminosite, bruit, artefacts de compression) puis de reentrainer, ce qui est bien plus rapide et moins couteux que de collecter un nouveau dataset diversifie depuis 14 sites physiques.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A financial services firm is building ML models in Amazon SageMaker Canvas to predict stock price trends. The datasets are stored in Amazon S3 and include large volumes of transactional records with complex structures, nested fields, and multiple data types. To minimize loading time and maximize data processing performance in Canvas, which file format should the data scientist choose?

options.A: JSON
options.B: CSV
options.C: Apache Parquet
options.D: XML

declencheurs: nested fields, and multiple data types
minimize loading time and maximize data processing performance
radar.signal: Gros volume + structures imbriquees + performance de chargement -> format colonnaire compresse Parquet

pieges.A: JSON gere les structures imbriquees mais reste un format texte non compresse/non colonnaire, plus lent a charger a grande echelle
pieges.B: CSV ne gere pas nativement les champs imbriques/types multiples et n'offre aucune compression colonnaire
pieges.D: XML est encore plus verbeux que JSON, le plus lent des quatre a charger sur de gros volumes

explication: Apache Parquet est un format colonnaire compresse qui gere nativement les structures imbriquees et les types de donnees complexes, offrant les meilleures performances de chargement et de traitement pour de larges volumes de donnees transactionnelles dans SageMaker Canvas, contrairement aux formats texte JSON, CSV ou XML.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A startup is deploying a personalization microservice on Amazon ECS with Fargate. The team uses Amazon CodeGuru Reviewer to detect code issues before release. They want code commits to automatically build, test, and deploy containerized applications to ECS in a repeatable, automated workflow. Which AWS service should they use to implement this continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline?

options.A: AWS CodePipeline
options.B: AWS CodeDeploy
options.C: AWS CodeBuild
options.D: Amazon CloudWatch

radar.signal: Orchestration complete build+test+deploy declenchee par un commit -> AWS CodePipeline (le service de PIPELINE qui enchaine les etapes)

pieges.B: CodeDeploy gere uniquement l'etape de DEPLOIEMENT, pas l'orchestration complete du build et des tests
pieges.C: CodeBuild gere uniquement l'etape de BUILD/TEST, pas l'enchainement bout-en-bout jusqu'au deploiement
pieges.D: CloudWatch est un service de monitoring, sans rapport avec l'orchestration d'un pipeline CI/CD

explication: AWS CodePipeline est le service d'orchestration qui relie les differentes etapes du cycle CI/CD (source, build via CodeBuild, deploiement via CodeDeploy/ECS) en un workflow automatise et repetable declenche a chaque commit, alors que CodeBuild et CodeDeploy ne couvrent chacun qu'une etape isolee du pipeline.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: A streaming company maintains a data lake in AWS Lake Formation containing structured and unstructured data, such as video metadata, user activity logs, and clickstream data. Data analysts are assigned to specific content categories (e.g., sports, movies, documentaries) and should access only the data relevant to their category via Amazon Athena. The solution must provide fine-grained access control while minimizing operational overhead. Which approach meets these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Glue workflows to tag data by content category and control access via IAM policies that reference these tags.
options.B: Use AWS Lake Formation to assign category-specific tags and manage access permissions based on these tags.
options.C: Use S3 bucket policies to limit access to folders for each category and configure Athena workgroups for query-level control.
options.D: Create separate S3 buckets for each content category and assign bucket-level permissions to analysts.

radar.signal: Controle d'acces fin par categorie dans un data lake Lake Formation -> LF-Tags (tag-based access control natif de Lake Formation)

pieges.A: Les policies IAM referencant des tags Glue ne fournissent pas le controle d'acces fin natif au niveau table/colonne que propose Lake Formation
pieges.C: Des policies S3 par dossier + workgroups Athena est une gestion plus manuelle et granulaire par ressource, plus d'overhead qu'un tagging centralise
pieges.D: Multiplier les buckets S3 par categorie complique la gestion et l'evolutivite par rapport a un controle par tags centralise

explication: AWS Lake Formation permet d'assigner des tags (LF-Tags) aux ressources du data lake par categorie de contenu et de gerer les permissions d'acces directement sur la base de ces tags, offrant un controle d'acces fin et centralise avec un minimum d'overhead operationnel comparativement a la gestion de policies IAM/S3 dispersees.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: You are a Machine Learning Engineer at a video streaming startup training a deep learning model in Amazon SageMaker to predict subscriber churn. The dataset has tens of millions of records, and training is taking longer than expected. The current setup uses a batch size of 192, 60 epochs, and a learning rate of 0.008. You want to reduce training time without hurting model convergence or performance. Which adjustment is most appropriate?

options.A: Increase the number of epochs while keeping the current batch size
options.B: Reduce the learning rate and increase the batch size
options.C: Increase the batch size and reduce the number of epochs.
options.D: Reduce the batch size and train for more epochs

declencheurs: training is taking longer than expected
reduce training time without hurting model convergence
radar.signal: Reduire le temps d'entrainement sans nuire a la convergence -> augmenter le batch size (meilleur parallelisme, moins de pas par epoch) et reduire les epochs

pieges.A: Plus d'epochs AUGMENTE le temps d'entrainement, contraire a l'objectif
pieges.B: Reduire le learning rate ralentit la convergence, ce qui allonge le temps necessaire pour atteindre une bonne performance
pieges.D: Reduire le batch size et faire plus d'epochs va dans le sens inverse d'un entrainement plus rapide

explication: Augmenter la taille du batch permet de mieux exploiter le parallelisme du materiel (GPU) et de traiter plus de donnees par pas de gradient, ce qui reduit le nombre de pas necessaires et donc le nombre d'epochs pour converger, diminuant le temps total d'entrainement sur un tres large volume de donnees sans sacrifier la convergence.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A company is using Amazon SageMaker Studio for ML development, with ten developers sharing a single SageMaker Studio domain. The team wants an automated alert system that notifies them when SageMaker compute costs exceed a set threshold. What is the most effective solution to implement this cost alerting?

options.A: Tag the SageMaker Studio user profiles, then configure AWS Cost Explorer to send alerts when the cost threshold is exceeded.
options.B: Assign tags to the SageMaker user profiles and set up AWS Budgets to trigger notifications when the costs surpass the threshold.
options.C: Add custom tags to resources by editing each SageMaker user profile and modifying tag propagation settings, then configure AWS Budgets to send alerts when the threshold is breached.
options.D: Apply resource tagging to IAM profiles for each user and use AWS Trusted Advisor to monitor resource costs and send recommendations.

declencheurs: notifies them when... costs exceed a set threshold
radar.signal: Alerte automatique sur un SEUIL de cout -> AWS Budgets (service dedie a l'alerting sur seuil), pas Cost Explorer

pieges.A: AWS Cost Explorer sert a l'analyse/visualisation des couts, il n'envoie pas nativement d'alertes automatiques sur seuil
pieges.C: Decrit une configuration plus complexe (edition manuelle de chaque profil, tag propagation) que necessaire, plus d'overhead pour le meme resultat
pieges.D: Trusted Advisor donne des recommandations generales d'optimisation, ce n'est pas un systeme d'alerte sur un seuil de cout personnalise

explication: AWS Budgets est le service concu specifiquement pour declencher des notifications automatiques lorsque les couts (filtres par tag de profil utilisateur SageMaker) depassent un seuil defini, ce qui correspond directement au besoin d'alerting, contrairement a Cost Explorer qui est un outil d'analyse sans alerting natif sur seuil.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A data science team is evaluating model types for a project that involves both generating content and predicting labels. Conceptually, what distinguishes generative models from discriminative models?

options.A: Generative models learn the underlying data distribution to produce new samples, while discriminative models learn decision boundaries to classify inputs.
options.B: Discriminative models are limited to image recognition, whereas generative models are used only for text generation.
options.C: Generative models need labeled datasets, while discriminative models can be trained on both labeled and unlabeled data.
options.D: Amazon Bedrock

radar.signal: Question de definition -> generatif = apprend la distribution des donnees ; discriminatif = apprend une frontiere de decision

pieges.B: Ni les modeles generatifs ni discriminatifs ne sont limites a un seul type de modalite (image ou texte)
pieges.C: C'est l'inverse qui est generalement vrai : les modeles discriminatifs sont typiquement entraines sur des donnees labellisees pour la classification
pieges.D: Amazon Bedrock est un service AWS, pas une reponse conceptuelle a une question de definition ML

explication: Les modeles generatifs apprennent la distribution de probabilite sous-jacente des donnees, ce qui leur permet de generer de nouveaux echantillons plausibles, tandis que les modeles discriminatifs apprennent directement une frontiere de decision entre classes pour la tache de classification, sans modeliser la distribution des donnees elle-meme.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A company stores transactional and customer data, including sensitive personally identifiable information (PII), in Amazon Redshift. A data analyst needs access to some columns for behavior analysis but must not see sensitive data, and the solution should avoid duplicating or transforming the dataset. What approach provides access control with minimal implementation effort?

options.A: Use Redshift row-level security to restrict access to certain rows while providing full column access.
options.B: Export the data to Amazon S3, anonymize sensitive fields using AWS Glue, and let the analyst query the transformed data.
options.C: Create a materialized view in Redshift that omits sensitive columns and grant the analyst access to this view.
options.D: Configure Amazon Redshift dynamic data masking to hide sensitive columns in real time while allowing access to non-sensitive fields.

declencheurs: avoid duplicating or transforming the dataset
radar.signal: Cacher des COLONNES sensibles sans copier/transformer les donnees -> Redshift dynamic data masking (natif, au niveau colonne, a la volee)

pieges.A: La row-level security restreint des LIGNES, pas des colonnes : elle ne cache pas les champs sensibles au sein d'une ligne autorisee
pieges.B: Exporter et anonymiser via Glue cree une copie transformee des donnees, contraire a l'exigence explicite
pieges.C: Une vue materialisee stocke physiquement une copie des donnees, ce qui viole 'avoid duplicating... the dataset'

explication: Le masquage dynamique de donnees (dynamic data masking) de Redshift permet de definir des politiques qui masquent certaines colonnes sensibles a la volee selon le role de l'utilisateur, sans dupliquer ni transformer physiquement le dataset source, ce qui repond exactement au besoin de controle d'acces au niveau colonne avec un effort d'implementation minimal.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A video subscription service is developing a churn prediction model using 300 plus customer attributes. Many features may be irrelevant, causing overfitting and longer training times. The team wants to keep only the inputs that most reduce training loss. Which feature engineering technique should they apply to identify the most relevant features?

options.A: Feature transformation
options.B: Feature extraction
options.C: Feature selection
options.D: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)

declencheurs: keep only the inputs that most reduce training loss
radar.signal: Garder un SOUS-ENSEMBLE des features EXISTANTES (pas en creer de nouvelles) -> Feature selection

pieges.A: La transformation modifie la representation des features existantes, elle ne selectionne pas un sous-ensemble
pieges.B: L'extraction cree de NOUVELLES features a partir des originales, different de garder un sous-ensemble des inputs d'origine
pieges.D: PCA est une technique d'extraction/reduction dimensionnelle qui cree de nouvelles composantes, ce n'est pas de la 'selection' des features brutes

explication: La feature selection consiste a identifier et conserver uniquement le sous-ensemble des features brutes existantes qui contribuent le plus a la reduction de la loss, sans creer de nouvelles variables (contrairement a l'extraction ou la PCA) ni simplement les transformer, ce qui reduit a la fois l'overfitting et le temps d'entrainement sur les 300+ attributs.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A data scientist has trained a deep learning model to predict customer churn. While the model achieves high accuracy on training data, it performs poorly on validation data. To improve generalization, the scientist plans to apply regularization techniques. What is the main advantage of using regularization?

options.A: Improvement of feature scaling
options.B: Prevention of overfitting
options.C: Reduction of training data requirements
options.D: Increased model complexity

radar.signal: Ecart train/validation + regularisation -> l'avantage principal est de PREVENIR l'overfitting

pieges.A: Le feature scaling est une etape de preprocessing distincte, sans rapport avec la regularisation
pieges.C: La regularisation ne reduit pas le besoin de donnees d'entrainement, elle ameliore la generalisation avec les donnees disponibles
pieges.D: La regularisation vise a LIMITER la complexite effective du modele, pas a l'augmenter

explication: La regularisation (L1/L2, dropout, etc.) penalise la complexite excessive du modele pendant l'entrainement, ce qui l'empeche de trop s'ajuster aux donnees d'entrainement (overfitting) et ameliore ainsi sa capacite a generaliser sur des donnees non vues, ce qui est precisement le probleme decrit (bonne accuracy en train, mauvaise en validation).
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A retail company wants to build a churn prediction model using AWS to identify customers likely to cancel subscriptions. The dataset includes purchase history and support logs in Amazon S3 and subscription data in an on-premises PostgreSQL database. The dataset presents two main challenges. Class imbalance, few customers are labeled as "churned," making it hard for the model to learn. Strong feature interactions, among categorical features like membership tier and numerical features like purchase frequency. Which SageMaker built-in algorithm can best handle these challenges with minimal operational effort?

options.A: Amazon SageMaker Random Cut Forest (RCF)
options.B: Amazon SageMaker K-Means
options.C: Amazon SageMaker Linear Learner
options.D: Amazon SageMaker Neural Topic Model (NTM)

radar.signal: Classification binaire supervisee avec desequilibre de classes -> seul algorithme de classification supervisee de la liste : Linear Learner (supporte le class weighting)

pieges.A: Random Cut Forest est un algorithme de detection d'ANOMALIES non supervise, pas de classification de churn
pieges.B: K-Means est du clustering non supervise, inadapte a une prediction binaire labellisee
pieges.D: Neural Topic Model fait du topic modeling sur du texte, sans rapport avec une classification tabulaire de churn

explication: Parmi les options proposees, seul SageMaker Linear Learner est un algorithme de classification binaire supervisee, capable de gerer le desequilibre de classes via une ponderation des classes integree, contrairement a RCF (anomalies), K-Means (clustering) et NTM (topic modeling sur texte) qui ne sont tout simplement pas adaptes a une tache de prediction de churn.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: Which AWS services are designed to help monitor machine learning models in production and integrate human-in-the-loop review for ML workflows? (Choose two)
