options.A: Use a model with a larger context window
options.B: Enable prompt caching and place the contract in a cache checkpoint at the start of the prompt
options.C: Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache the model's answers
options.D: Increase the temperature to reduce processing time

radar.signal: Prefixe de prompt long et repete -> Bedrock prompt caching (cache checkpoint) : moins de tokens factures et latence reduite

pieges.A: Une fenetre plus grande ne reduit pas le nombre de tokens retraites a chaque question
pieges.C: Cacher les reponses ne sert a rien : chaque question est differente
pieges.D: La temperature n'a aucun effet sur le cout ni sur le temps de traitement de l'entree

explication: Avec le prompt caching, le prefixe statique (le contrat) est mis en cache apres la premiere requete. Les questions suivantes relisent ce prefixe depuis le cache, a un tarif fortement reduit et avec une latence bien plus faible. Il faut placer le contenu repete au debut du prompt et marquer un cache checkpoint juste apres.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: During daily traffic peaks, an application that uses on-demand Amazon Bedrock invocations in us-east-1 receives ThrottlingException errors. The company does not want long-term capacity commitments, and data may be processed in other US Regions. What should the ML engineer do?

options.A: Purchase 6-month Provisioned Throughput
options.B: Add a retry loop with no backoff
options.C: Deploy a copy of the application in every US Region
options.D: Invoke the model through a US cross-Region inference profile instead of the single-Region model ID

radar.signal: Throttling on-demand + autres regions autorisees -> cross-Region inference profile (repartition automatique du trafic, sans surcout)

pieges.A: Provisioned Throughput impose un engagement, ce que l'entreprise refuse
pieges.B: Des retries sans backoff aggravent le throttling
pieges.C: Dupliquer l'application dans chaque region est complexe et inutile

explication: Un inference profile cross-Region (par exemple us.) achemine automatiquement les requetes vers d'autres regions de la meme zone geographique quand la region source est saturee. Le debit disponible augmente sans engagement et sans surcout. Il suffit de remplacer l'ID du modele par l'ID du profil, et de garder des retries avec backoff exponentiel.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: Five business units share the same Amazon Bedrock foundation model in one AWS account. Finance needs to track and allocate the token costs of each business unit in AWS Cost Explorer. What should the ML engineer do?

options.A: Create an application inference profile for each business unit with a cost allocation tag, and have each unit invoke the model through its own profile
options.B: Create a separate IAM user for each business unit
options.C: Ask each business unit to log its usage in a spreadsheet
options.D: Create a CloudWatch dashboard of the InputTokenCount metric

declencheurs: allocate token costs per business unit
radar.signal: Repartir le cout Bedrock par equipe -> application inference profiles taggues (cost allocation tags) visibles dans Cost Explorer

pieges.B: Les utilisateurs IAM ne sont pas une dimension de facturation dans Cost Explorer
pieges.C: Un suivi manuel n'est ni fiable ni automatise
pieges.D: Les metriques CloudWatch donnent un volume, pas une allocation de cout dans la facturation

explication: Un application inference profile encapsule un modele (ou un profil cross-Region) et peut porter des tags. Une fois ces tags actives comme cost allocation tags, les couts d'invocation de chaque profil apparaissent par tag dans Cost Explorer et dans les rapports de cout. Les profils fournissent aussi des metriques CloudWatch separees.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: An ML engineer must choose an instance type for a new SageMaker AI real-time endpoint. The goal is the lowest cost per inference that still meets a P99 latency of 100 ms, but the engineer does not know which instance family fits best. What should the engineer do with the LEAST effort?

options.A: Deploy the model on every instance type for a week and compare the bills
options.B: Run an Amazon SageMaker Inference Recommender job (default or advanced load test) and choose the recommended configuration
options.C: Always choose the largest GPU instance to guarantee latency
options.D: Use AWS Compute Optimizer on the training instances

radar.signal: Choisir le type d'instance d'un endpoint selon cout et latence -> SageMaker Inference Recommender (load tests automatises)

pieges.A: Tester chaque type en production pendant une semaine est long et couteux
pieges.C: La plus grosse instance GPU respecte la latence mais coute le plus cher
pieges.D: Compute Optimizer analyse EC2/Lambda/EBS, pas le choix d'instances d'un endpoint SageMaker

explication: Inference Recommender lance automatiquement des tests de charge sur plusieurs types d'instances et configurations, puis compare le cout par inference, le debit et la latence. Le mode advanced permet de fixer un objectif de latence (par exemple P99 a 100 ms) et renvoie la configuration la moins chere qui le respecte.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: An ML team builds custom inference containers and pushes them to Amazon ECR from an AWS CodePipeline pipeline. Security requires that images with critical operating system or Python package vulnerabilities never be deployed to SageMaker AI. What should the ML engineer do?

options.A: Enable Amazon Macie on the ECR repository
options.B: Enable Amazon GuardDuty Malware Protection for Amazon S3
options.C: Enable Amazon Inspector enhanced scanning for Amazon ECR and add a pipeline step that checks the scan findings and fails the deployment if critical vulnerabilities are found
options.D: Review AWS Trusted Advisor security checks monthly

radar.signal: Vulnerabilites (CVE) des images de conteneurs -> Amazon Inspector (scan ECR OS + paquets de langage) + quality gate dans le pipeline

pieges.A: Macie detecte des donnees sensibles dans S3, il ne scanne pas les images de conteneurs
pieges.B: GuardDuty Malware Protection pour S3 analyse des objets S3 a la recherche de malware, pas des CVE dans des images ECR
pieges.D: Trusted Advisor n'analyse pas le contenu des images et une revue mensuelle n'empeche pas le deploiement

explication: Le scan ameliore d'Amazon Inspector analyse en continu les images ECR, y compris les paquets du systeme et des langages comme pip, et publie des findings par severite. Une etape du pipeline (CodeBuild ou Lambda) interroge ces findings et bloque le deploiement en cas de vulnerabilite critique. Pour le code source lui-meme, des outils d'analyse statique comme Amazon CodeGuru completent ce controle.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A production application running on AWS Lambda must invoke Amazon Bedrock models. The security team requires that no long-lived credentials be stored in code or environment variables. Which credential type should the ML engineer use?

options.A: A long-term Amazon Bedrock API key stored in a Lambda environment variable
options.B: The access keys of an IAM user stored in AWS Secrets Manager
options.C: The AWS account root user credentials
options.D: The Lambda execution role (IAM role) with a policy that allows bedrock:InvokeModel on the required models only

radar.signal: Workload AWS en production -> role IAM (credentials temporaires automatiques) au moindre privilege ; les cles API Bedrock servent surtout a l'exploration

pieges.A: Une cle API long terme est une credential longue duree stockee en clair, exactement ce qui est interdit
pieges.B: Des access keys d'utilisateur IAM restent des credentials longue duree, meme stockees dans Secrets Manager
pieges.C: Le root user ne doit jamais etre utilise par une application

explication: Les cles API Bedrock (court terme ou long terme) simplifient l'acces pour des tests ou des outils externes, mais pour une application qui tourne sur AWS, la bonne pratique est un role IAM. Lambda recoit automatiquement des credentials temporaires renouvelees, et la policy limite les actions (bedrock:InvokeModel) aux seuls modeles necessaires.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A bank deploys a customer-facing chatbot on Amazon Bedrock. The chatbot must refuse to give investment recommendations, and it must never reveal account numbers or email addresses in its responses. Which Amazon Bedrock Guardrails policies should the ML engineer configure? (Choose two.)

options.A: A denied topic that describes investment advice
options.B: A contextual grounding check with a high threshold
options.C: Content filters for violence set to HIGH
options.D: Sensitive information filters for email addresses and a regex pattern for account numbers, with the mask or block action
options.E: A word filter that contains the word 'invest'

declencheurs: never reveal account numbers or emails
radar.signal: Sujet interdit -> denied topics ; donnees sensibles (PII + format maison) -> sensitive information filters (types PII + regex)

pieges.B: Le contextual grounding detecte les hallucinations, pas un sujet interdit ni des PII
pieges.C: Le filtre de violence ne concerne ni le conseil financier ni les PII
pieges.E: Un filtre de mots est trop grossier : il bloque des usages legitimes ('investigate') et rate les reformulations

explication: Les denied topics decrivent en langage naturel un sujet a refuser (le conseil en investissement), et detectent les reformulations bien mieux qu'une liste de mots. Les sensitive information filters detectent des types de PII predefinis (EMAIL...) ainsi que des motifs regex personnalises (numero de compte), et les masquent ou les bloquent en entree comme en sortie.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A RAG application on Amazon Bedrock sometimes answers with facts that do not appear in the retrieved documents. The company wants to automatically block responses that are not supported by the source content or that are irrelevant to the user's question. What should the ML engineer configure?

options.A: Lower the temperature to 0
options.B: Increase the number of retrieved chunks
options.C: An Amazon Bedrock guardrail with contextual grounding checks (grounding and relevance thresholds)
options.D: Content filters for misconduct

radar.signal: Hallucinations en RAG a bloquer -> Guardrails contextual grounding check (score de grounding + score de relevance)

pieges.A: Une temperature a 0 reduit la variabilite mais n'empeche pas les hallucinations et ne bloque rien
pieges.B: Plus de contexte peut aider mais ne garantit pas le blocage des reponses non fondees
pieges.D: Les content filters ciblent les contenus nuisibles, pas l'exactitude factuelle

explication: Le contextual grounding check compare la reponse a la source de reference (les chunks recuperes) et a la question. Il calcule un score de grounding (la reponse est-elle fondee sur la source ?) et un score de relevance (repond-elle a la question ?), et bloque les reponses sous les seuils configures.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A company's security policy requires that all Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint configurations use an AWS KMS key to encrypt the attached storage. The ML engineer must continuously detect and report noncompliant endpoint configurations across the account. What should the engineer do?

options.A: Enable the AWS Config managed rule sagemaker-endpoint-configuration-kms-key-configured
options.B: Search CloudTrail logs manually every month
options.C: Enable Amazon Macie for SageMaker AI
options.D: Create a CloudWatch alarm on the endpoint Invocations metric

radar.signal: Conformite continue de la configuration des ressources -> AWS Config (regle geree sagemaker-endpoint-configuration-kms-key-configured)

pieges.B: Une recherche manuelle mensuelle n'est pas continue et ne donne pas d'etat de conformite
pieges.C: Macie decouvre des donnees sensibles dans S3, il n'evalue pas la configuration des endpoints
pieges.D: Le nombre d'invocations ne dit rien du chiffrement

explication: AWS Config enregistre la configuration des ressources et evalue en continu des regles de conformite. La regle geree sagemaker-endpoint-configuration-kms-key-configured signale chaque configuration d'endpoint sans cle KMS. On peut y ajouter une remediation automatique, une notification SNS et une agregation multi-comptes avec un conformance pack.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: An application runs on Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets with no internet gateway or NAT gateway. The application must invoke Amazon Bedrock models, and traffic must not traverse the public internet. What should the ML engineer do?

options.A: Add a NAT gateway and restrict outbound traffic with a security group
options.B: Create an interface VPC endpoint (AWS PrivateLink) for the Amazon Bedrock runtime service and allow HTTPS from the instances in the endpoint security group
options.C: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon Bedrock
options.D: Assign Elastic IP addresses to the instances

radar.signal: Acces prive a un service AWS (hors S3/DynamoDB) -> interface VPC endpoint PrivateLink (com.amazonaws.<region>.bedrock-runtime)

pieges.A: Un NAT gateway fait sortir le trafic vers les endpoints publics, ce qui est interdit
pieges.C: Les gateway endpoints n'existent que pour S3 et DynamoDB
pieges.D: Des IP publiques exposent les instances a internet

explication: Une interface VPC endpoint pour bedrock-runtime cree des ENI privees dans les sous-reseaux. Avec le private DNS active, le SDK resout le nom public du service vers ces IP privees, et le trafic reste sur le reseau AWS. Une endpoint policy peut en plus restreindre les modeles et les actions autorises.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A healthcare company runs distributed training on multiple Amazon SageMaker AI instances in a VPC with sensitive patient data. Compliance requires that all data in transit be encrypted, including the traffic exchanged between training nodes, and that training containers have no outbound internet access. Which configuration meets these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Enable inter-container traffic encryption on the training job
options.B: Use Amazon S3 server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3) only
options.C: Use larger instances to reduce the number of nodes
options.D: Enable network isolation on the training job
options.E: Enable Amazon CloudWatch detailed monitoring

radar.signal: Chiffrement entre noeuds -> EnableInterContainerTrafficEncryption ; aucun acces reseau sortant -> EnableNetworkIsolation

pieges.B: SSE-S3 chiffre les donnees au repos dans S3, pas le trafic entre noeuds d'entrainement
pieges.C: Moins de noeuds reduit le trafic sans le chiffrer, et ce n'est pas une garantie de conformite
pieges.E: La surveillance ne chiffre rien et ne bloque aucun acces reseau

explication: L'option inter-container traffic encryption chiffre les echanges entre les noeuds d'un entrainement distribue, au prix d'un temps d'entrainement un peu plus long. La network isolation empeche les conteneurs d'effectuer tout appel reseau sortant, y compris vers internet ou d'autres services AWS ; SageMaker gere lui-meme le telechargement des donnees depuis S3 et l'upload des artefacts.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A startup is experimenting with several foundation models on Amazon Bedrock. Its monthly generative AI spending must not exceed USD 5,000, and the team wants to be alerted when forecasted spending is expected to exceed 80% of this amount. What should the ML engineer configure?

options.A: An AWS Budgets cost budget filtered on Amazon Bedrock with an alert on forecasted spend at 80%
options.B: An Amazon CloudWatch alarm on the Invocations metric
options.C: AWS Trusted Advisor cost optimization checks
options.D: A weekly manual review in AWS Cost Explorer

radar.signal: Plafond de cout + alerte sur la prevision -> AWS Budgets (budget de cout filtre par service, seuil forecasted a 80%)

pieges.B: Le nombre d'invocations ne traduit pas directement un cout (les tokens varient d'une requete a l'autre)
pieges.C: Trusted Advisor ne donne pas de seuil budgetaire ni d'alerte sur une prevision
pieges.D: Une revue manuelle n'est pas une alerte automatique

explication: AWS Budgets permet de creer un budget de cout mensuel filtre sur le service Amazon Bedrock, avec des alertes sur le cout reel ou previsionnel (forecasted) a un seuil donne, envoyees par email ou SNS. Des budget actions peuvent meme appliquer automatiquement une policy IAM restrictive si le seuil est depasse.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A hospital needs 400,000 chest X-ray images labeled for a classification model. The images contain protected health information and must be labeled only by the hospital's own radiologists. Labeling is expensive, so the hospital wants to minimize the number of images that radiologists must label manually. Which combination of Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth features meets these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use the Amazon Mechanical Turk public workforce
options.B: Use a private workforce made up of the hospital's radiologists
options.C: Use a vendor workforce from AWS Marketplace
options.D: Enable automated data labeling, which uses active learning to label the images that the model can label with high confidence
options.E: Export the images to Amazon Rekognition and use its labels as ground truth

radar.signal: Donnees confidentielles -> private workforce ; reduire le volume etiquete a la main -> automated data labeling (active learning)

pieges.A: Mechanical Turk = travailleurs publics, interdit pour des donnees de sante
pieges.C: Un vendor tiers n'est pas compose des radiologues de l'hopital
pieges.E: Les labels generiques de Rekognition ne sont pas des diagnostics medicaux fiables

explication: Une private workforce limite l'acces aux images aux employes designes (ici les radiologues), ce qui respecte la confidentialite. L'automated data labeling entraine un modele au fil de l'eau : il etiquette lui-meme les images ou sa confiance est elevee et n'envoie aux humains que les cas difficiles, ce qui reduit fortement le cout sur un gros volume.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A company already streams clickstream events through an Amazon MSK cluster. The ML team wants these events stored in Amazon S3 as Apache Parquet files, partitioned by date, so that they can be used for model training. The team wants the solution with the LEAST operational overhead. What should the ML engineer do?

options.A: Write a Kafka consumer application on Amazon EC2 that converts the events to Parquet and uploads them to S3
options.B: Create an Amazon Data Firehose stream with the MSK cluster as the source, enable record format conversion to Parquet with an AWS Glue Data Catalog table schema, and set S3 as the destination with a date-based prefix
options.C: Use an AWS Glue crawler on the MSK topic
options.D: Replace Amazon MSK with Amazon Kinesis Data Streams

radar.signal: MSK -> S3 en Parquet sans code -> Firehose avec source MSK + record format conversion (schema Glue) + prefixe date

pieges.A: Un consumer custom sur EC2 = code, scaling et disponibilite a gerer
pieges.C: Un crawler Glue catalogue des donnees deja stockees, il ne consomme pas un topic Kafka
pieges.D: Migrer toute l'ingestion existante est un effort disproportionne

explication: Amazon Data Firehose accepte un cluster MSK comme source. Il peut convertir les enregistrements JSON en Parquet ou ORC grace a un schema stocke dans le Glue Data Catalog, puis les ecrire dans S3 avec des prefixes dynamiques (par exemple year=/month=/day=). Le tout est gere : aucun consumer a ecrire ou a operer.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A payment company needs a real-time feature, 'average transaction amount per card over a sliding 10-minute window updated every 30 seconds', computed from an Amazon Kinesis data stream. The computation must be stateful, must handle late-arriving events, and must provide exactly-once processing. Which service should the ML engineer use?

options.A: AWS Lambda with a Kinesis event source mapping and tumbling windows
options.B: Amazon Data Firehose with a Lambda transformation
options.C: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink
options.D: An AWS Glue batch job scheduled every 10 minutes

radar.signal: Fenetres glissantes + etat + evenements en retard (watermarks) + exactly-once -> Managed Service for Apache Flink

pieges.A: Les fenetres Lambda sont des tumbling windows (sans chevauchement), sans gestion avancee des evenements en retard
pieges.B: La transformation Firehose est sans etat, enregistrement par enregistrement
pieges.D: Un batch toutes les 10 minutes n'est pas temps reel et ne fait pas de fenetre glissante toutes les 30 secondes

explication: Apache Flink est concu pour le traitement de flux avec etat : fenetres glissantes (sliding/hopping), event time avec watermarks pour les evenements en retard, et checkpoints pour la semantique exactly-once. Le service gere fait tourner l'application sans cluster a administrer. Lambda ne propose que des tumbling windows de 15 minutes au plus.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: Data scientists run Amazon Athena queries on a 40 TB dataset of CSV files in Amazon S3 to build training sets. Each query selects 6 of the 180 columns and filters on a single month of data. Queries are slow and expensive. Which changes will MOST reduce query cost and time? (Choose two.)

options.A: Convert the data to Apache Parquet
options.B: Compress the CSV files with GZIP and keep the same layout
options.C: Partition the data in S3 by year and month and register the partitions in the AWS Glue Data Catalog
options.D: Move the data to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access
options.E: Split the data into many 1 KB files to increase parallelism

radar.signal: Peu de colonnes lues -> format colonnaire (Parquet) ; filtre temporel -> partitionnement (partition pruning)

pieges.B: GZIP reduit les octets lus, mais Athena doit toujours lire toutes les colonnes et tous les mois
pieges.D: S3-IA reduit le cout de stockage mais ajoute des frais de recuperation et n'accelere rien
pieges.E: De tres petits fichiers degradent les performances (overhead d'ouverture de fichiers)

explication: Athena facture au volume scanne. Parquet est colonnaire et compresse : seules les 6 colonnes utiles sont lues. Le partitionnement par annee et mois permet le partition pruning : seul le dossier du mois filtre est parcouru. Combinees, ces deux optimisations reduisent souvent le volume scanne de plus de 95%.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A team retrains a computer vision model every day on the same 12 million small JPEG images (about 50 KB each) stored in Amazon S3, using File mode. Each job spends most of its time downloading data before training starts, and GPU utilization stays low. Which actions will improve data loading performance? (Choose two.)

options.A: Pack the images into larger shard files (for example, RecordIO, TFRecord, or WebDataset tar shards of 100 MB to 1 GB)
options.B: Use a larger GPU instance type
options.C: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system linked to the S3 bucket and mount it in the training jobs, so that objects are cached after the first access
options.D: Switch the input to FastFile mode while keeping the 12 million small objects
options.E: Increase the number of training epochs

radar.signal: Petits fichiers + repetition quotidienne -> regrouper en gros shards (correction durable) ou FSx for Lustre lie a S3 (cache apres le premier acces)

pieges.B: Un GPU plus puissant attendra encore plus les donnees : le goulot est l'E/S, pas le calcul
pieges.D: FastFile vise les gros fichiers ; avec des objets de 50 Ko, le cout par requete domine et le gain est faible
pieges.E: Plus d'epoques allonge l'entrainement sans regler le chargement

explication: Chaque requete S3 a une latence fixe : lire des millions de petits objets coute bien plus que lire quelques milliers de gros fichiers, et FastFile n'y change presque rien. Regrouper les images en shards de dizaines a centaines de Mo est la correction durable. FSx for Lustre lie au bucket est la correction quand le jeu est relu souvent : les objets sont mis en cache au premier acces, et les entrainements suivants ne paient plus le telechargement (VPC requis).
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: An ML engineer must build a nightly training dataset by joining customer profiles stored in Amazon RDS for MySQL with 3 TB of purchase history stored as Parquet files in Amazon S3. The output must be written back to S3. The solution must be serverless and must scale to the data volume. What should the engineer do?

options.A: Create an AWS Glue ETL job that reads RDS through a JDBC connection and S3 through the Glue Data Catalog, joins the data with Apache Spark, and writes Parquet to S3
options.B: Write an AWS Lambda function that queries RDS and S3 and joins the data in memory
options.C: Export RDS to CSV manually every night and join the files in a Jupyter notebook
options.D: Load the 3 TB of purchase history into the RDS instance and join the tables with SQL

radar.signal: Fusion de sources heterogenes a grande echelle en serverless -> AWS Glue ETL (Spark) avec connexion JDBC + Data Catalog

pieges.B: Lambda est limitee a 15 minutes et 10 Go de memoire : impossible de joindre 3 To en memoire
pieges.C: Un processus manuel dans un notebook n'est ni automatise ni scalable
pieges.D: Charger 3 To dans RDS surcharge la base transactionnelle et ne la rend pas adaptee aux jointures analytiques

explication: AWS Glue execute des jobs Spark serverless qui peuvent lire une base relationnelle via une connexion JDBC (dans le VPC) et des donnees S3 via le Data Catalog, puis distribuer la jointure sur plusieurs workers. Le resultat est ecrit en Parquet dans S3, et le job peut etre planifie chaque nuit avec un trigger Glue ou EventBridge.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: An ML engineer trains a model to forecast next-week product demand from 3 years of daily sales data. The model shows 4% error on the test set but 25% error in production. The engineer used a random 80/20 split of all rows. What is the MOST likely cause, and how should the engineer fix it?

options.A: The model is underfitting; add more layers
options.B: The test set is too small; use a 50/50 random split
options.C: The data is imbalanced; apply SMOTE
options.D: The random split leaks future information into training; use a time-based split in which the test set contains only dates after the training period

declencheurs: good test score but bad production
radar.signal: Series temporelles + split aleatoire -> fuite de donnees du futur ; utiliser un split chronologique

pieges.A: Une erreur de test de 4% n'indique pas un underfitting : c'est la validation qui est faussee
pieges.B: Un autre ratio aleatoire garde la meme fuite temporelle
pieges.C: SMOTE s'applique a la classification desequilibree, pas a une prevision de demande

explication: Avec un split aleatoire, des jours posterieurs aux jours de test se retrouvent dans l'entrainement : le modele 'voit le futur', et l'evaluation est optimiste. Pour des donnees temporelles, il faut entrainer sur le passe et tester sur une periode strictement posterieure (ou faire une validation glissante) afin de reproduire les conditions de production.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: Before training a loan approval model, a bank must check whether the proportion of positive labels (approved) in the historical data differs significantly between applicants of different age groups. The check must run as part of an automated pipeline. What should the ML engineer use?

options.A: Amazon SageMaker Clarify pre-training bias metrics, such as Difference in Proportions of Labels (DPL), computed in a processing job
options.B: SageMaker Model Monitor model quality monitoring
options.C: SHAP values computed after training
options.D: Amazon Macie sensitive data discovery

declencheurs: proportion of positive labels differs between groups
radar.signal: Biais dans les donnees avant entrainement -> Clarify pre-training bias (DPL, CI) dans un processing job/pipeline

pieges.B: Model Monitor model quality surveille la precision d'un modele deja deploye
pieges.C: SHAP explique les predictions d'un modele entraine, pas la distribution des labels dans les donnees
pieges.D: Macie detecte des donnees sensibles, il ne mesure pas de biais

explication: SageMaker Clarify calcule des metriques de biais avant entrainement. Class Imbalance (CI) mesure la sous-representation d'un groupe ; Difference in Proportions of Labels (DPL) compare la proportion de labels positifs entre groupes, exactement le controle demande. Clarify s'execute comme processing job et s'integre a une etape de SageMaker Pipelines.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: An ML engineer prepares features for a linear regression model. The 'annual_income' feature is strongly right-skewed with a long tail, and the 'age' feature has a non-linear relationship with the target that differs across life stages. Which feature engineering steps are MOST appropriate? (Choose two.)

options.A: Apply a log transformation to annual_income
options.B: Apply one-hot encoding to annual_income
options.C: Remove the age feature
options.D: Bin age into ranges (for example, 18-25, 26-40, 41-60, 60+) and encode the bins
options.E: Multiply all features by 1,000

radar.signal: Distribution asymetrique -> log transform ; relation non lineaire par paliers -> binning

pieges.B: Le one-hot sur une variable continue cree une colonne par valeur unique : non-sens
pieges.C: Supprimer l'age perd une information predictive ; il faut la transformer
pieges.E: Multiplier par une constante ne change ni l'asymetrie ni la non-linearite

explication: La transformation logarithmique comprime la longue queue d'une variable asymetrique comme le revenu, ce qui rapproche sa distribution d'une normale et limite l'influence des valeurs extremes sur un modele lineaire. Le binning transforme l'age en categories, et permet a un modele lineaire de capter un effet different selon la tranche de vie.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A dataset contains 'distance_km' (0-5,000) and 'number_of_children' (0-6). An ML engineer will train both a k-nearest neighbors (k-NN) model and an XGBoost model on it. For which model is feature scaling (standardization or normalization) required to avoid one feature dominating the others?

options.A: Only XGBoost
options.B: Only k-NN
options.C: Both models
options.D: Neither model

radar.signal: Algorithmes bases sur des distances (k-NN, k-means, SVM) -> scaling obligatoire ; arbres (XGBoost, Random Forest) -> insensibles a l'echelle

pieges.A: Les arbres de decision font des coupures par seuil : l'echelle d'une variable ne change pas l'ordre des valeurs
pieges.C: XGBoost n'a pas besoin de scaling, cela ajoute seulement une etape inutile
pieges.D: Sans scaling, la distance k-NN est dominee par distance_km

explication: k-NN calcule des distances euclidiennes : une difference de 1 000 km ecrase totalement une difference de 3 enfants, donc il faut standardiser ou normaliser. Les modeles a base d'arbres comparent chaque variable a des seuils, independamment de son echelle : une transformation monotone comme le scaling ne change pas leurs decoupages.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: An ML engineer builds a churn training dataset from Amazon SageMaker Feature Store. Each training example has a label timestamp. The engineer discovers that some feature values were recorded after the label timestamp, which inflates offline accuracy. How should the engineer build the dataset to prevent this leakage?

options.A: Read the latest feature values from the online store for every customer
options.B: Drop the event_time feature from the feature group
options.C: Use the Feature Store dataset builder (create_dataset) on the offline store with a point-in-time accurate join based on each example's label timestamp
options.D: Shuffle the dataset before training

declencheurs: feature values recorded after the label timestamp
radar.signal: Eviter la fuite temporelle dans un dataset de features -> point-in-time join sur l'offline store (event_time)

pieges.A: Le online store ne garde que la derniere valeur : c'est precisement une valeur du futur
pieges.B: event_time est obligatoire : c'est lui qui permet la jointure temporelle correcte
pieges.D: Melanger ne change pas les valeurs de features utilisees

explication: L'offline store conserve l'historique de chaque feature avec son event_time. Le dataset builder du SDK Feature Store peut produire une jointure point-in-time : pour chaque exemple, il prend la valeur de la feature telle qu'elle existait juste avant le timestamp du label. Le modele est ainsi entraine avec les informations reellement disponibles au moment de la prediction.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: An AWS Glue ETL job ingests partner files whose schemas change often. Some new columns may contain email addresses, phone numbers, or credit card numbers without being documented. Before the data is used for training, PII must be detected in any column and replaced with a hash. Which solution requires the LEAST custom code?

options.A: Write regular expressions in the Glue script for each known column name
options.B: Add the Detect Sensitive Data transform to the Glue job, configured to scan all columns and apply a hashing action to detected PII
options.C: Run Amazon Macie on the output bucket once a month
options.D: Encrypt the entire output with AWS KMS

radar.signal: Detection et transformation de PII dans un job Glue, quelle que soit la colonne -> transform Detect Sensitive Data (redact/hash)

pieges.A: Des regex par nom de colonne ratent les nouvelles colonnes non documentees
pieges.C: Macie detecte apres coup, mensuellement, et ne hashe rien
pieges.D: Le chiffrement global protege le stockage, mais les PII restent lisibles pour l'entrainement

explication: La transformation Detect Sensitive Data d'AWS Glue inspecte le contenu des colonnes (et pas seulement leur nom) pour reperer des types de PII predefinis ou des motifs personnalises. Elle applique ensuite une action : redaction, hachage ou simple signalement. Elle s'ajoute dans Glue Studio sans code, et fonctionne meme quand le schema evolue.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A healthcare provider wants to build ML features from unstructured clinical notes. The provider needs to extract medical conditions, medications, and dosages, and to map conditions to ICD-10-CM codes. The provider also wants to store and query the resulting patient data in the FHIR standard. Which AWS services should the ML engineer use? (Choose two.)

options.A: Amazon Comprehend Medical
options.B: Amazon Textract
options.C: AWS HealthLake
options.D: Amazon Kendra
options.E: Amazon Translate

radar.signal: Entites medicales + codes ICD-10 -> Comprehend Medical ; stockage et requetes au format FHIR -> AWS HealthLake

pieges.B: Textract extrait du texte de documents scannes, sans comprehension medicale
pieges.D: Kendra est un moteur de recherche d'entreprise, pas un extracteur d'entites medicales
pieges.E: Translate traduit du texte, il n'extrait pas d'entites

explication: Amazon Comprehend Medical detecte les entites medicales (pathologies, medicaments, dosages, frequences) et propose des ontologies comme ICD-10-CM et RxNorm. AWS HealthLake est un data store compatible HIPAA qui stocke, transforme et interroge les donnees de sante au standard FHIR, et integre lui-meme l'extraction NLP medicale.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A data lake in Amazon S3 is cataloged in the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Data scientists query it with Amazon Athena to build training sets. They must be able to read all columns of the customers table except ssn and date_of_birth, while the compliance team can read every column. The company wants central, fine-grained governance without duplicating data. What should the ML engineer do?

options.A: Create a second copy of the table without the sensitive columns in another S3 bucket
options.B: Use S3 bucket policies to deny access to the sensitive columns
options.C: Encrypt the sensitive columns with a different KMS key
options.D: Register the S3 location with AWS Lake Formation and grant column-level permissions that exclude ssn and date_of_birth to the data scientists' role

radar.signal: Controle d'acces au niveau colonne sur un data lake -> Lake Formation (column-level / data filters)

pieges.A: Une copie double le stockage et cree des divergences de donnees
pieges.B: Les bucket policies agissent au niveau objet, pas au niveau colonne
pieges.C: Le chiffrement n'est pas une gestion fine des permissions, et il est complexe a appliquer par colonne

explication: AWS Lake Formation centralise les permissions sur les tables du Data Catalog, avec une granularite colonne, ligne ou cellule (data filters). Athena applique ces permissions a la requete : les data scientists voient la table sans les colonnes sensibles, la conformite voit tout, et il n'existe qu'une seule copie des donnees.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A company must transfer 80 TB of image data from an on-premises NFS file server to Amazon S3 for model training. New images are added every day and must also be synchronized each night. The company has a 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect link. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync with an agent on premises, with a scheduled task that transfers data over Direct Connect to S3
options.B: Write a cron script that runs aws s3 sync on the file server
options.C: Order an AWS Snowball device every night
options.D: Mount the NFS share on a SageMaker notebook and copy the files manually

radar.signal: Transfert initial + synchronisation planifiee depuis NFS/SMB vers S3 -> AWS DataSync (agent, planification, verification d'integrite)

pieges.B: Un script cron demande gestion des erreurs, retries, parallelisme et supervision
pieges.C: Snowball sert aux transferts ponctuels hors ligne, pas a une synchronisation quotidienne
pieges.D: Une copie manuelle n'est ni fiable ni automatisee

explication: AWS DataSync automatise le transfert entre stockage sur site (NFS, SMB, HDFS) et S3, avec chiffrement, verification d'integrite, parallelisme et limitation de bande passante. Une tache planifiee ne transfere chaque nuit que les fichiers nouveaux ou modifies, et peut utiliser le lien Direct Connect via un VPC endpoint.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: An ML engineer fine-tunes a BERT-based model, which has a 512-token maximum input length, to classify legal documents. Many documents are 5,000 to 20,000 tokens long, and the label often depends on clauses near the end of the document. Default truncation keeps only the first 512 tokens, and accuracy is poor. What should the engineer do?

options.A: Remove all stop words so that the documents fit into 512 tokens
options.B: Increase the batch size
options.C: Split each document into overlapping 512-token chunks with a sliding window, classify each chunk, and aggregate the chunk predictions per document
options.D: Truncate from the start instead of the end

declencheurs: label depends on end of document
radar.signal: Texte plus long que la fenetre du modele -> decoupage en fenetres glissantes avec chevauchement + agregation des predictions

pieges.A: Retirer les stop words ne divise pas un texte de 20 000 tokens par 40
pieges.B: La taille de batch ne change pas la longueur d'entree maximale
pieges.D: Garder seulement la fin perd les informations du debut : le probleme est seulement deplace

explication: Le decoupage en fenetres glissantes, avec un chevauchement pour ne pas couper une clause en deux, permet au modele de lire tout le document. Les predictions des chunks sont ensuite agregees (max, moyenne ou vote) pour obtenir le label du document. Une alternative est un modele a fenetre de contexte plus longue.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A fraud dataset contains 0.2% positive examples. An ML engineer will train an XGBoost model on Amazon SageMaker AI. Which actions are appropriate to handle the class imbalance? (Choose two.)

options.A: Apply SMOTE to the entire dataset before splitting it into training and test sets
options.B: Set the scale_pos_weight hyperparameter to approximately the ratio of negative to positive examples
options.C: Use accuracy as the objective metric
options.D: Apply oversampling (for example, SMOTE) only to the training split, and keep the validation and test sets with the original distribution
options.E: Remove all positive examples that look like outliers

radar.signal: Desequilibre -> ponderer la classe minoritaire (scale_pos_weight) et/ou reechantillonner UNIQUEMENT le jeu d'entrainement

pieges.A: SMOTE avant le split fait fuiter des exemples synthetiques derives du test dans l'entrainement
pieges.C: Avec 0,2% de fraude, predire toujours 'non fraude' donne 99,8% d'accuracy
pieges.E: Supprimer des fraudes atypiques retire justement les cas les plus importants a detecter

explication: scale_pos_weight augmente le poids des exemples positifs dans la loss de XGBoost (valeur typique : nombre de negatifs / nombre de positifs). Le reechantillonnage est aussi valable, mais seulement sur le jeu d'entrainement, apres le split : les jeux de validation et de test doivent refleter la distribution reelle pour donner une evaluation honnete (avec PR AUC, F1 ou recall plutot que l'accuracy).
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: An ML team has three trained models for credit risk: a gradient boosted tree model, a logistic regression model, and a neural network. Each model performs best on different customer segments, and no single model is best overall. The team wants to combine them to improve overall predictive performance. Which approach should the team use?

options.A: Keep only the model with the highest training accuracy
options.B: Average the hyperparameters of the three models
options.C: Retrain the neural network with more epochs
options.D: Use stacking: train a meta-model that takes the predictions of the three base models as input features

radar.signal: Modeles heterogenes aux forces complementaires -> ensemble par stacking (meta-learner sur les predictions)

pieges.A: Garder un seul modele perd les forces des autres, et l'accuracy d'entrainement est un mauvais critere
pieges.B: Moyenner des hyperparametres de modeles differents n'a aucun sens
pieges.C: Plus d'epoques risque l'overfitting sans exploiter les autres modeles

explication: Le stacking entraine un meta-modele (souvent simple, comme une regression logistique) sur les predictions out-of-fold des modeles de base. Il apprend quand faire confiance a chaque modele, et exploite leurs erreurs decorrelees pour depasser le meilleur modele individuel.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A single deep decision tree reaches 99% accuracy on the training data but only 78% on the validation data. Predictions change significantly when the model is retrained on slightly different samples. Which ensemble technique primarily addresses this problem?

options.A: Bagging, such as a random forest that averages many trees trained on bootstrap samples
options.B: Boosting with a higher learning rate
options.C: Increasing the maximum tree depth
options.D: Removing the validation set

declencheurs: predictions change with slightly different samples
radar.signal: Variance elevee (overfitting instable) -> bagging (random forest) ; biais eleve -> boosting

pieges.B: Le boosting reduit surtout le biais, et un learning rate eleve augmente le risque d'overfitting
pieges.C: Un arbre plus profond overfit encore plus
pieges.D: Retirer la validation masque le probleme sans le resoudre

explication: Le bagging entraine de nombreux modeles sur des echantillons bootstrap differents, puis moyenne leurs predictions. Cela reduit la variance d'un modele instable comme un arbre profond. La random forest ajoute un tirage aleatoire des features a chaque split, pour decorreler encore plus les arbres.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A data scientist has a working PyTorch training script that reads data from a local folder and saves the model to a local path. The team wants to run it on Amazon SageMaker AI managed training with the fewest code changes and without maintaining a custom container. What should the ML engineer do?

options.A: Build a custom Docker image with PyTorch and push it to Amazon ECR
options.B: Use the SageMaker PyTorch estimator in script mode with the script as entry_point, read input from SM_CHANNEL_TRAINING, and save the model to SM_MODEL_DIR
options.C: Rewrite the model with the SageMaker built-in XGBoost algorithm
options.D: Run the script on a SageMaker notebook instance

radar.signal: Script existant d'un framework supporte -> script mode (estimator PyTorch/TensorFlow/sklearn) + variables d'environnement SM_*

pieges.A: Un conteneur custom ajoute une image a construire, securiser et maintenir
pieges.C: Changer d'algorithme oblige a tout reecrire
pieges.D: Un notebook n'est pas un entrainement gere (pas de scaling, ni de tracabilite du job)

explication: En script mode, SageMaker utilise un conteneur PyTorch pre-construit et y execute le script fourni. Il suffit de lire les donnees dans le chemin donne par SM_CHANNEL_TRAINING (/opt/ml/input/data/training) et d'ecrire le modele dans SM_MODEL_DIR (/opt/ml/model). Les hyperparametres sont passes en arguments de ligne de commande, et un requirements.txt permet d'ajouter des dependances.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: An ML team runs SageMaker automatic model tuning (AMT) every month on new data. Each tuning job takes 2 days because many trials with poor hyperparameters run to completion, and every new job starts from scratch even though last month's tuning results are still relevant. Which actions will reduce tuning time? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use the Hyperband tuning strategy so that poorly performing training jobs are stopped early
options.B: Switch to grid search over all hyperparameter combinations
options.C: Increase the number of hyperparameters to tune
options.D: Use a warm start tuning job with the previous month's tuning job as parent
options.E: Set the maximum number of parallel training jobs to 1

radar.signal: Arreter tot les mauvais essais -> Hyperband (ou early stopping) ; reutiliser les resultats passes -> warm start

pieges.B: La grid search teste toutes les combinaisons : c'est la strategie la plus lente
pieges.C: Plus d'hyperparametres agrandit l'espace de recherche et allonge le tuning
pieges.E: Un seul job en parallele allonge la duree totale

explication: Hyperband alloue les ressources dynamiquement et arrete tot les configurations peu prometteuses, en se basant sur les metriques intermediaires. Le warm start initialise un nouveau tuning avec les resultats d'un ou plusieurs jobs parents (IDENTICAL_DATA_AND_ALGORITHM ou TRANSFER_LEARNING), ce qui evite de reexplorer les zones deja connues comme mauvaises.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: An ML engineer moves a training job from 1 GPU with a batch size of 64 to 8 GPUs with data parallelism, using a global batch size of 512. The learning rate is unchanged. The model now converges much more slowly per epoch and reaches lower accuracy. Which adjustment should the engineer try FIRST?

options.A: Reduce the learning rate by a factor of 8
options.B: Go back to a batch size of 64 per epoch on 8 GPUs without changing anything else
options.C: Scale the learning rate proportionally to the batch size (about 8x), with a warm-up period at the start of training
options.D: Remove the validation set to speed up training

radar.signal: Batch global plus grand -> moins d'updates par epoque -> augmenter le learning rate proportionnellement (linear scaling rule) + warm-up

pieges.A: Reduire le learning rate ralentit encore la convergence
pieges.B: Garder un petit batch global sous-utilise les 8 GPU et annule l'interet du parallelisme
pieges.D: La validation ne ralentit pas la convergence, elle sert a la mesurer

explication: Avec un batch global 8 fois plus grand, chaque epoque fait 8 fois moins de mises a jour des poids. La regle d'echelle lineaire consiste a multiplier le learning rate par le meme facteur que le batch, avec un warm-up progressif pour eviter l'instabilite des premieres iterations. C'est le premier reglage a faire apres un passage en entrainement distribue.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: During training of a deep neural network on Amazon SageMaker AI, the training loss suddenly becomes NaN after a few hundred steps. Amazon SageMaker Debugger reports that the ExplodingTensor rule was triggered. Which actions should the ML engineer take? (Choose two.)

options.A: Apply gradient clipping
options.B: Increase the learning rate
options.C: Remove batch normalization layers
options.D: Lower the learning rate
options.E: Increase the number of epochs

radar.signal: Gradients qui explosent -> gradient clipping + learning rate plus bas (et eventuellement normalisation)

pieges.B: Un learning rate plus eleve amplifie les mises a jour et aggrave l'explosion
pieges.C: La batch normalization stabilise l'entrainement, la retirer aggrave le probleme
pieges.E: Plus d'epoques ne corrige pas une loss deja a NaN

explication: Une loss qui devient NaN apres des valeurs de plus en plus grandes est le signe de gradients qui explosent. Le gradient clipping plafonne la norme des gradients, et un learning rate plus faible reduit l'amplitude des mises a jour. Debugger detecte ce cas avec la regle ExplodingTensor et peut arreter automatiquement le job.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A company runs hundreds of training jobs per week on Amazon SageMaker AI. Many jobs continue for hours after the loss has stopped decreasing, which wastes compute. The ML engineer wants to automatically stop any job whose loss stops improving, without modifying the training scripts. What should the engineer configure?

options.A: An Amazon CloudWatch alarm on CPUUtilization
options.B: A shorter MaxRuntimeInSeconds for every job
options.C: SageMaker Model Monitor on the training jobs
options.D: The SageMaker Debugger built-in rule LossNotDecreasing with the built-in StopTraining action

radar.signal: Arreter automatiquement un entrainement qui ne progresse plus -> Debugger built-in rule (LossNotDecreasing) + action StopTraining

pieges.A: L'utilisation CPU ne dit pas si la loss diminue
pieges.B: Une duree maximale fixe coupe aussi les jobs qui progressent encore
pieges.C: Model Monitor surveille des endpoints en production, pas des jobs d'entrainement

explication: SageMaker Debugger capture les tenseurs pendant l'entrainement et evalue des regles integrees (LossNotDecreasing, Overfit, VanishingGradient, ExplodingTensor...). Les actions integrees peuvent arreter le job (StopTraining) ou envoyer une notification quand une regle se declenche, sans modifier le script avec les conteneurs de frameworks supportes.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A regulator requires a bank to explain to each rejected applicant which factors contributed most to the rejection of that specific application. The bank uses an XGBoost model hosted on Amazon SageMaker AI. What should the ML engineer provide?

options.A: Global feature importance from the XGBoost model
options.B: Partial dependence plots (PDPs) for each feature
options.C: Local SHAP values for each prediction, computed with SageMaker Clarify (for example, with online explainability on the endpoint)
options.D: The confusion matrix of the model

radar.signal: Explication par prediction individuelle (locale) -> valeurs SHAP de Clarify ; explication globale -> feature importance / PDP

pieges.A: L'importance globale decrit le modele en moyenne, pas la decision prise pour un client precis
pieges.B: Les PDP montrent l'effet moyen d'une feature sur tout le dataset : explication globale
pieges.D: La matrice de confusion mesure la performance, elle n'explique rien

explication: Les valeurs SHAP attribuent a chaque feature sa contribution a une prediction precise, par rapport a une baseline. SageMaker Clarify les calcule en batch (processing job) ou en temps reel avec online explainability, ce qui renvoie l'explication avec chaque inference. Les PDP et l'importance globale ne decrivent que le comportement moyen du modele.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A churn model in production shows stable input feature distributions according to SageMaker Model Monitor data quality checks. However, business stakeholders notice that the model now relies mostly on 'support_tickets' instead of 'contract_length' to make predictions, which differs from the training-time behavior. Which monitoring capability detects this type of change?

options.A: Model Monitor feature attribution drift monitoring, which uses SageMaker Clarify to compare the ranking of feature attributions with a training baseline
options.B: Model Monitor data quality monitoring with stricter thresholds
options.C: CloudWatch ModelLatency alarms
options.D: AWS CloudTrail data events

radar.signal: Changement de l'importance des features en production -> feature attribution drift (Model Monitor + Clarify, score NDCG)

pieges.B: La data quality surveille les distributions d'entree, deja stables ici
pieges.C: La latence ne dit rien du comportement du modele
pieges.D: CloudTrail trace des appels d'API, pas le comportement d'un modele

explication: Model Monitor propose quatre types de surveillance : data quality, model quality, bias drift et feature attribution drift. Ce dernier calcule periodiquement les attributions SHAP sur les donnees capturees, et compare le classement des features a la baseline d'entrainement avec un score NDCG. Une baisse de ce score revele que le modele s'appuie sur d'autres features qu'a l'entrainement.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: An insurance company must predict claim approval. Regulations require that every model decision can be fully traced to explicit rules that auditors can read, and the company accepts slightly lower accuracy in exchange. Which model type should the ML engineer choose?

options.A: A deep neural network with SHAP explanations
options.B: A shallow decision tree with limited depth
options.C: A large ensemble of 1,000 gradient boosted trees
options.D: A fine-tuned large language model

radar.signal: Interpretabilite intrinseque exigee -> modele simple et transparent (arbre peu profond, regression lineaire/logistique)

pieges.A: SHAP fournit une approximation post-hoc, pas des regles explicites et completes
pieges.C: Un ensemble de 1 000 arbres n'est pas lisible par un auditeur
pieges.D: Un LLM est une boite noire, non deterministe et non tracable en regles

explication: Quand la reglementation exige que chaque decision soit tracable en regles lisibles, il faut un modele intrinsequement interpretable. Un arbre de decision peu profond se lit comme une suite de conditions SI/ALORS. Les methodes d'explication post-hoc (SHAP, LIME) eclairent les modeles complexes, mais ne les rendent pas transparents.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A retail company wants to detect its own brand logos on shelf photos. It has 400 labeled images. The team has no deep learning expertise and wants a solution with the LEAST development effort. What should the ML engineer use?

options.A: Amazon Rekognition DetectLabels
options.B: A custom object detection model trained from scratch on Amazon SageMaker AI
options.C: Amazon Textract
options.D: Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels

radar.signal: Objets specifiques a l'entreprise + peu d'images + pas d'expertise -> Rekognition Custom Labels (AutoML vision)

pieges.A: DetectLabels reconnait des concepts generiques ('logo', 'bouteille'), pas la marque precise
pieges.B: Entrainer un detecteur from scratch demande expertise et beaucoup plus de donnees
pieges.C: Textract extrait du texte et des formulaires, pas des logos graphiques

explication: Rekognition Custom Labels entraine un modele de classification ou de detection d'objets specifique a partir de quelques centaines d'images etiquetees, en s'appuyant sur le transfer learning. Aucune expertise en deep learning n'est requise : il suffit de fournir les images annotees, puis de demarrer le modele pour l'inference.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: An ML team wants to fine-tune a 70-billion-parameter model. The model's weights, gradients, and optimizer states do not fit in the memory of a single GPU, even on the largest available instance. Which training approach should the ML engineer use?

options.A: Data parallelism only, which replicates the full model on each GPU
options.B: Increase the batch size
options.C: Model parallelism, such as sharded data parallelism (FSDP) or tensor and pipeline parallelism with the SageMaker model parallelism library
options.D: Use a CPU instance with more RAM

declencheurs: does not fit in memory of a single GPU
radar.signal: Modele trop grand pour un GPU -> parallelisme de modele / sharding (FSDP, tensor, pipeline) ; dataset trop grand -> data parallelism

pieges.A: Le data parallelism copie tout le modele sur chaque GPU : il ne tient toujours pas
pieges.B: Un batch plus grand augmente la memoire necessaire
pieges.D: Entrainer un 70B sur CPU serait beaucoup trop lent

explication: Quand le modele ne tient pas sur un seul GPU, il faut le repartir. Le sharded data parallelism (FSDP / ZeRO) partitionne parametres, gradients et etats de l'optimiseur entre les GPU. Le tensor parallelism coupe les couches, et le pipeline parallelism repartit les couches entre GPU. La SageMaker model parallelism library (SMP) prend en charge ces techniques. Le data parallelism seul accelere l'entrainement sur de gros datasets, mais suppose que le modele tienne sur chaque GPU.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A logistics company receives scanned delivery forms from hundreds of suppliers, each with a different layout. The company needs to extract only three values from each form: the delivery date, the PO number, and the total weight. It does not want to build a template per supplier. Which solution requires the LEAST effort?

options.A: Use Amazon Textract AnalyzeDocument with the Queries feature, asking questions such as 'What is the PO number?'
options.B: Use Amazon Textract DetectDocumentText and write regular expressions for each supplier layout
options.C: Train a custom named entity recognition model on SageMaker AI
options.D: Use Amazon Comprehend key phrase extraction on the images

radar.signal: Extraire des champs precis de documents a mise en page variable -> Textract Queries (questions en langage naturel)

pieges.B: Des regex par fournisseur reviennent a creer un template par fournisseur
pieges.C: Un modele NER custom demande des donnees etiquetees et un entrainement
pieges.D: Comprehend ne lit pas les images et les key phrases ne ciblent pas des champs precis

explication: La fonctionnalite Queries de Textract permet de poser des questions en langage naturel sur un document ('What is the PO number?'). Textract renvoie la reponse avec un score de confiance, quelle que soit la mise en page. C'est ideal quand les formats sont nombreux et que seuls quelques champs sont utiles. Les Custom Queries (adapters) permettent d'ameliorer encore la precision.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A fraud detection model is evaluated on a test set in which 0.5% of transactions are fraudulent. Missing a fraud is very costly, but too many false alerts overload the investigation team. Which metrics are MOST appropriate to compare candidate models? (Choose two.)

options.A: Accuracy
options.B: Area under the precision-recall curve (PR AUC)
options.C: Mean squared error (MSE)
options.D: F1 score (or F-beta with beta greater than 1 to favor recall)
options.E: R-squared

radar.signal: Classification tres desequilibree + compromis rappel/precision -> PR AUC et F1 / F-beta

pieges.A: L'accuracy est trompeuse : un modele qui ne detecte rien obtient 99,5%
pieges.C: La MSE est une metrique de regression
pieges.E: Le R2 est une metrique de regression

explication: Sur des donnees tres desequilibrees, la PR AUC est plus informative que la ROC AUC, car elle se concentre sur la classe positive rare. Le F1 equilibre precision (peu de fausses alertes) et recall (peu de fraudes manquees). Le F-beta avec beta > 1 donne plus de poids au recall quand une fraude manquee coute plus cher qu'une fausse alerte.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A regression model predicts delivery times. The data contains occasional extreme delays caused by rare events that the business does not want to dominate model selection. Which evaluation metric is MOST appropriate?

options.A: Root mean squared error (RMSE)
options.B: Mean absolute error (MAE)
options.C: Area under the ROC curve (AUC)
options.D: Precision

radar.signal: Regression robuste aux valeurs extremes -> MAE ; RMSE penalise fortement les grosses erreurs (carre)

pieges.A: La RMSE eleve les erreurs au carre : quelques retards extremes dominent la metrique
pieges.C: L'AUC est une metrique de classification
pieges.D: La precision est une metrique de classification

explication: La MAE fait la moyenne des erreurs absolues : chaque erreur compte proportionnellement a sa taille, ce qui la rend robuste aux valeurs aberrantes. La RMSE eleve les erreurs au carre, donc quelques retards extremes pesent enormement, ce qui est souhaitable seulement quand les grosses erreurs sont particulierement couteuses.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A media company wants a foundation model on Amazon Bedrock to write article summaries in its very specific editorial style (tone, structure, vocabulary). Prompt engineering with few-shot examples has improved results, but the style is still inconsistent. The company has 8,000 examples of articles paired with summaries written by its editors. Which approach should the ML engineer choose NEXT?

options.A: Build a RAG solution with the 8,000 summaries in a knowledge base
options.B: Use continued pre-training on raw articles without summaries
options.C: Increase the temperature to make the summaries more creative
options.D: Fine-tune a supported model on Amazon Bedrock with the 8,000 article-summary pairs as prompt-completion data

radar.signal: Adapter le style ou le comportement avec des exemples etiquetes, apres echec du prompt engineering -> fine-tuning supervise

pieges.A: Le RAG apporte des connaissances factuelles, il ne change pas durablement le style d'ecriture
pieges.B: Le pre-entrainement continu sur des articles bruts n'apprend pas la tache de resume dans le style voulu
pieges.C: Une temperature plus elevee rend le style encore moins constant

explication: La regle generale : connaissances qui changent -> RAG ; style, format ou comportement -> fine-tuning. Avec des milliers de paires exemple/resultat de qualite, et apres avoir epuise le prompt engineering, le fine-tuning supervise apprend au modele le ton et la structure editoriale de facon constante, avec des prompts plus courts.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: An ML engineer trains an image classification model on a 5 TB dataset. One training run takes 4 days on a single ml.p4d.24xlarge instance, and the model fits easily in GPU memory. The team needs results in less than 1 day. Which actions will reduce training time? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use distributed data parallel training across multiple instances (for example, with the SageMaker distributed data parallelism library or PyTorch DDP)
options.B: Switch to model parallelism to split the model across GPUs
options.C: Enable early stopping based on the validation metric
options.D: Increase the number of epochs
options.E: Use a CPU instance type with more vCPUs

radar.signal: Gros dataset + modele qui tient en memoire -> data parallelism multi-instances ; ne pas entrainer inutilement -> early stopping

pieges.B: Le model parallelism sert quand le modele ne tient pas en memoire ; ici il ajoute de la communication sans benefice
pieges.D: Plus d'epoques allonge l'entrainement
pieges.E: Des CPU sont bien plus lents que des GPU pour de la vision

explication: Le data parallelism repartit les batches sur plusieurs GPU et instances, chacun ayant une copie du modele, et synchronise les gradients. Le temps par epoque diminue presque lineairement. L'early stopping arrete l'entrainement des que la metrique de validation ne s'ameliore plus, ce qui evite des epoques inutiles.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A model requires the same scikit-learn preprocessing (imputation and one-hot encoding) at inference time that was used during training, followed by an XGBoost prediction and a post-processing step that converts scores to labels. The client application must make a single call. The ML engineer wants to reuse the trained preprocessing artifacts. What should the engineer deploy?

options.A: Three separate SageMaker AI endpoints that the client calls in sequence
options.B: A SageMaker AI inference pipeline model that chains the preprocessing, XGBoost, and post-processing containers on a single endpoint
options.C: A multi-model endpoint that hosts the three models
options.D: An AWS Lambda function that reimplements the preprocessing logic

radar.signal: Chaine pretraitement -> modele -> post-traitement en un appel -> inference pipeline (2 a 15 conteneurs en serie)

pieges.A: Trois endpoints = trois appels reseau, plus de latence et de cout, et une logique de chainage cote client
pieges.C: Un multi-model endpoint sert un seul modele par requete, il ne les chaine pas
pieges.D: Reimplementer le pretraitement cree un risque de training-serving skew

explication: Un inference pipeline model execute 2 a 15 conteneurs en serie sur les memes instances : la sortie de chaque conteneur devient l'entree du suivant. On reutilise les artefacts de pretraitement entraines (par exemple un modele SparkML ou scikit-learn), ce qui garantit le meme traitement qu'a l'entrainement, avec un seul appel InvokeEndpoint.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: A team has five models built with different frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, scikit-learn, and a custom container). Each model receives low and irregular traffic, and the client must be able to call each model individually. The team wants to reduce hosting costs by sharing infrastructure. Which deployment option should the ML engineer use?

options.A: A multi-model endpoint
options.B: An inference pipeline
options.C: A multi-container endpoint with direct invocation, in which the client specifies the TargetContainerHostname
options.D: Five separate real-time endpoints

radar.signal: Frameworks differents sur un endpoint, chacun appele individuellement -> multi-container endpoint en direct invocation

pieges.A: Un multi-model endpoint exige que tous les modeles partagent le meme conteneur ou framework
pieges.B: Un inference pipeline enchaine les conteneurs, il ne permet pas d'appeler un modele isolement
pieges.D: Cinq endpoints separes multiplient le cout pour un trafic faible

explication: Un multi-container endpoint heberge jusqu'a 15 conteneurs differents sur les memes instances. En mode direct invocation, le client choisit le conteneur cible avec l'en-tete TargetContainerHostname. C'est la solution pour mutualiser des modeles heterogenes. Le multi-model endpoint convient plutot a des milliers de modeles d'un meme framework.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: A company serves a transformer-based text classification model to millions of requests per day on GPU-based SageMaker AI endpoints. The company wants to significantly reduce the cost per inference while keeping high throughput and low latency. The team can compile the model with a supported SDK. Which instance family should the ML engineer evaluate?

options.A: AWS Inferentia2-based instances (ml.inf2) with the AWS Neuron SDK
options.B: AWS Trainium-based instances (ml.trn1)
options.C: Memory-optimized instances (ml.r5)
options.D: Burstable instances (ml.t3)

radar.signal: Inference deep learning a grande echelle au meilleur cout -> instances Inferentia (inf2) + Neuron SDK ; entrainement -> Trainium

pieges.B: Trainium est optimise pour l'entrainement, pas pour servir l'inference
pieges.C: Des instances memoire sans accelerateur sont lentes pour un transformer a grand volume
pieges.D: Les instances burstables ne tiennent pas une charge soutenue

explication: Les puces AWS Inferentia2 sont concues pour l'inference de modeles de deep learning, transformers compris. Elles offrent un meilleur rapport performance/cout que des GPU comparables pour un trafic eleve. Le modele doit etre compile avec le Neuron SDK (integre a PyTorch et TensorFlow). Trainium est l'equivalent pour l'entrainement.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: An ML platform team wants to define its training infrastructure (S3 buckets, IAM roles, SageMaker AI domain, and SageMaker Pipelines) as code, in Python, with reusable high-level components and references between stacks (for example, a networking stack that exports VPC subnets to an ML stack). Which tool should the ML engineer use?

options.A: AWS Systems Manager Run Command
options.B: The AWS CLI in shell scripts
options.C: Manual configuration in the AWS Management Console with documentation
options.D: The AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK)

radar.signal: IaC dans un langage de programmation, avec constructs reutilisables et references entre stacks -> AWS CDK (synthetise du CloudFormation)

pieges.A: Run Command execute des commandes sur des instances, ce n'est pas de l'IaC
pieges.B: Des scripts CLI sont imperatifs, sans gestion d'etat ni rollback
pieges.C: Une configuration manuelle n'est ni reproductible ni versionnee

explication: AWS CDK permet de definir l'infrastructure en Python, TypeScript, Java et d'autres langages, avec des constructs reutilisables, puis la synthetise en templates CloudFormation (gestion d'etat, rollback). Les references entre stacks sont gerees automatiquement : passer un objet VPC d'une stack a une autre cree les exports et imports CloudFormation necessaires.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: A large company has 40 data science teams. Each team must be able to create, in self-service, a complete MLOps project (code repository, CI/CD pipeline, SageMaker Pipelines, and Model Registry group) that follows the company's approved security standards, without requesting broad IAM permissions. What should the ML engineer implement?

options.A: Grant AdministratorAccess to every team
options.B: Use SageMaker Projects with organization-approved templates published as AWS Service Catalog products
options.C: Share a wiki page with step-by-step instructions
options.D: Create one shared SageMaker Pipeline for all teams

radar.signal: Provisionnement standardise et gouverne en self-service -> SageMaker Projects (templates Service Catalog)

pieges.A: AdministratorAccess viole le moindre privilege
pieges.C: Une procedure manuelle n'est ni standardisee ni controlee
pieges.D: Un pipeline partage ne donne ni isolation ni autonomie aux equipes

explication: SageMaker Projects provisionne un projet MLOps complet a partir d'un template AWS Service Catalog (CloudFormation) approuve par l'organisation. Les utilisateurs lancent le produit sans avoir les droits sur les ressources sous-jacentes : Service Catalog utilise un launch role. Chaque equipe obtient ainsi un environnement conforme, en self-service.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: An ML engineer trains a model with the SageMaker AI prebuilt PyTorch container in script mode. The training script now needs two additional open-source Python packages available on PyPI. What is the simplest way to add them?

options.A: Build a new container from scratch that includes PyTorch and the two packages
options.B: Ask AWS Support to add the packages to the prebuilt container
options.C: Add a requirements.txt file that lists the packages to the source_dir that is passed to the estimator
options.D: Switch to a SageMaker AI built-in algorithm

radar.signal: Quelques dependances pip en plus -> requirements.txt dans source_dir ; changement profond (librairies systeme) -> etendre l'image prebuilt

pieges.A: Construire un conteneur from scratch est la solution la plus lourde
pieges.B: AWS ne personnalise pas les conteneurs a la demande
pieges.D: Un algorithme integre ne permet pas d'executer le script PyTorch

explication: Les conteneurs de frameworks SageMaker installent automatiquement les paquets listes dans un requirements.txt present dans le source_dir avant de lancer le script. Si les dependances sont lourdes (librairies systeme, temps d'installation long a chaque job) ou si le job n'a pas d'acces internet, on etend plutot l'image prebuilt avec un Dockerfile FROM et on la pousse dans Amazon ECR.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: A company deploys a SageMaker AI real-time endpoint in private subnets of a VPC that has no internet gateway or NAT gateway. The endpoint fails to start because it cannot download the model artifacts from Amazon S3. In addition, applications in the same VPC must invoke the endpoint privately. Which actions should the ML engineer take? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 gateway VPC endpoint and add it to the route tables of the private subnets
options.B: Attach an internet gateway to the VPC
options.C: Create an interface VPC endpoint for the SageMaker Runtime API (sagemaker.runtime)
options.D: Make the model artifacts public in Amazon S3
options.E: Move the endpoint to a public subnet

declencheurs: private subnets, no internet or NAT
cannot download model artifacts from S3
radar.signal: Acces S3 sans internet -> gateway endpoint S3 ; appel InvokeEndpoint prive -> interface endpoint sagemaker.runtime

pieges.B: Une internet gateway expose le VPC, contraire a l'architecture privee
pieges.D: Rendre des artefacts publics est une faille de securite, et la route vers S3 manque toujours
pieges.E: Un sous-reseau public ne respecte pas l'exigence d'isolation

explication: Dans un VPC sans internet, l'endpoint SageMaker a besoin d'une route privee vers S3 pour telecharger model.tar.gz : le gateway endpoint S3 la fournit gratuitement. Pour que les applications appellent InvokeEndpoint sans quitter le reseau AWS, il faut une interface VPC endpoint (PrivateLink) pour com.amazonaws.<region>.sagemaker.runtime. Les security groups doivent autoriser le HTTPS.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: An ML engineer must deploy a trained model to a real-time endpoint by using Boto3 only (low-level API), as part of a deployment script. In which order must the engineer call the SageMaker API operations?

options.A: create_endpoint, then create_endpoint_config, then create_model
options.B: create_endpoint_config, then create_model, then create_endpoint
options.C: create_model, then create_endpoint, then create_endpoint_config
options.D: create_model, then create_endpoint_config, then create_endpoint

radar.signal: Model (image + artefacts + role) -> EndpointConfig (variants, instances) -> Endpoint

pieges.A: L'endpoint a besoin d'une configuration existante, qui elle-meme reference un modele existant
pieges.B: La configuration reference un ModelName qui doit deja exister
pieges.C: create_endpoint exige un EndpointConfigName existant

explication: create_model enregistre l'image d'inference, l'emplacement des artefacts dans S3 et le role d'execution. create_endpoint_config definit les production variants (modele, type et nombre d'instances, poids). create_endpoint deploie l'infrastructure a partir de cette configuration. Pour mettre a jour un endpoint, on cree une nouvelle configuration puis on appelle update_endpoint.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: A company uses a SageMaker AI asynchronous inference endpoint to process document-analysis requests that arrive in bursts a few times per day. Between bursts, there is no traffic. The company wants to pay nothing for instances when the queue is empty and to scale out automatically when requests accumulate. How should the ML engineer configure auto scaling?

options.A: Set the minimum capacity to 0 and use a scaling policy based on the ApproximateBacklogSizePerInstance metric
options.B: Set the minimum capacity to 1 and scale on CPUUtilization
options.C: Scale on the InvocationsPerInstance metric with a minimum capacity of 2
options.D: Use a scheduled action that starts 10 instances every hour

radar.signal: Async inference -> scaler sur la file d'attente (ApproximateBacklogSizePerInstance) avec MinCapacity = 0

pieges.B: Une instance minimum est facturee en permanence, et le CPU ne mesure pas la file d'attente
pieges.C: Deux instances minimum coutent meme sans trafic
pieges.D: Une planification fixe ne suit pas des pics irreguliers et paie des instances inutiles

explication: Les endpoints asynchrones mettent les requetes en file d'attente et peuvent descendre a zero instance. La metrique ApproximateBacklogSizePerInstance (taille de la file divisee par le nombre d'instances) est le bon signal de scaling. Pour repartir de zero, on ajoute une step scaling policy sur HasBacklogWithoutCapacity afin de lancer une premiere instance quand une requete arrive.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: An ML engineer updates the model behind a business-critical SageMaker AI real-time endpoint. The engineer wants to first send 10% of traffic to the new model for 15 minutes and then shift all traffic, with an automatic rollback if the error rate or latency increases during the rollout. Which configuration meets these requirements with the LEAST effort?

options.A: Update the endpoint with an all-at-once blue/green deployment and monitor CloudWatch manually
options.B: Create a second endpoint and change the application code to call it
options.C: Use a shadow test with the new model as the shadow variant
options.D: Use SageMaker deployment guardrails with blue/green canary traffic shifting (10% canary, 15-minute baking period) and Amazon CloudWatch alarms configured for auto-rollback

radar.signal: Deploiement progressif + rollback automatique sur alarmes -> deployment guardrails (blue/green canary ou linear) + CloudWatch alarms

pieges.A: All-at-once envoie 100% du trafic d'un coup, et une surveillance manuelle n'est pas un rollback automatique
pieges.B: Modifier le code client est risque et ne fournit ni bascule progressive ni rollback
pieges.C: Un shadow test ne sert jamais de reponses du nouveau modele aux utilisateurs : ce n'est pas un deploiement
